Volkswagen AG.company_description: Volkswagen AG, known internationally as the Volkswagen Group, is a German multinational automotive manufacturer. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes passenger and commercial vehicles, motorcycles, engines and turbomachinery, as well as offers related services, including financing, leasing, and fleet management. It sells passenger cars under various brands such as Audi, Bentley, Cupra, Jetta, Lamborghini, Porsche, SEAT, Škoda, and Volkswagen. It also sells motorcycles under the Ducati name, light commercial vehicles under the Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles brand, and heavy commercial vehicles via the marques of the listed subsidiary Traton (Navistar, MAN, Scania, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus). The Volkswagen Group operates in roughly 150 countries and has 100 production facilities across 27 countries. It is the world's largest automaker by sales and has maintained the largest market share in Europe for over two decades.

Uniper SE.company_description: Uniper SE is a German multinational energy company based in Düsseldorf, Germany. It was formed in 2016 as a separate company from E.ON's fossil fuel assets. Uniper operates in over 40 countries and employs about 11,000 people. The company has faced criticism for opening new coal-fueled power plants in Germany. It was also involved in the Nord Stream 2 project, which was suspended after the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Uniper was nationalized in December 2022.

Schwarz-Gruppe.company_description: The Schwarz-Gruppe, headed by Dieter Schwarz, is a German retail group that operates the Kaufland and Lidl discount supermarkets. With revenue of over $140 billion, the Schwarz-Gruppe is one of the most successful business enterprises in Europe. The group has over 575,000 employees and has been steadily growing its revenue in recent years. The Schwarz-Gruppe is also involved in investing in artificial intelligence technology in Germany.

Mercedes-Benz Group AG.company_description: The Mercedes-Benz Group AG, formerly known as Daimler AG, is a German multinational automotive corporation. It is one of the world's leading car manufacturers and is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany. The company operates in the automotive industry and offers a range of products under the Mercedes-Benz brand, including cars, vans (including Mercedes-AMG and Mercedes-Maybach), and Smart vehicles. It also has shares in other vehicle manufacturers such as Daimler Truck, Denza, BAIC Motor, and Aston Martin. The Mercedes-Benz Group is known for its luxury and high-performance vehicles and is a major player in the global automotive market.

BMW AG.company_description: BMW AG, also known as Bayerische Motoren Werke AG, is a German multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles and motorcycles. The company was founded in 1916 and has its headquarters in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. BMW produces automobiles under the brands BMW, Mini, and Rolls-Royce, and motorcycles under the brand BMW Motorrad. They have a significant history in motor-sport and are known for their touring cars, sports cars, and motorcycles. BMW operates in various countries including Germany, Brazil, China, India, Mexico, the Netherlands, South Africa, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The company is publicly owned, with long-term investments by the Quandt family. In 2022, BMW was the 7th largest automaker by revenue.

E.ON SE.company_description: E.ON SE is a German multinational electric utility company based in Essen, Germany. It operates as one of the world's largest investor-owned electric utility service providers. The company operates in over 30 countries and has over 50 million customers. It was created in 2000 through the merger of VEBA and VIAG. In 2016, it separated its conventional power generation and energy trading operations into a new company, Uniper, while retaining retail, distribution, and nuclear operations. E.ON has also made significant moves towards renewable energy and has acquired the utility portion of renewable energy utility Innogy.

Deutsche Telekom AG.company_description: Deutsche Telekom AG is a German telecommunications company headquartered in Bonn. It is the largest telecommunications provider in Europe by revenue. The company operates several subsidiaries worldwide, including the mobile communications brand T-Mobile.

Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG.company_description: Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG is a German international discount retailer chain that operates over 12,000 stores across Europe and the United States. It is part of the Schwarz Group, which is the largest European retailer and the fourth-largest retailer in the world by revenue. Lidl is known for its private label brands and competes with Aldi in several markets. The company is headquartered in Neckarsulm, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

DHL Group.company_description: DHL Group is a German multinational package delivery and supply chain management company. It is one of the world's largest courier companies and operates in over 220 countries and territories. The company is a successor to the German mail authority Deutsche Bundespost and offers services in both postal and parcel divisions. The postal division, Deutsche Post, delivers millions of letters each day in Germany, while the parcel division, DHL, provides international courier and express mail services. DHL Group is listed on the Börse Frankfurt and is part of the Euro Stoxx 50 stock market index.

Robert Bosch GmbH.company_description: Robert Bosch GmbH, commonly known as Bosch, is a German multinational engineering and technology company. It operates in four business sectors: mobility, consumer goods, industrial technology, and energy and building technology. Bosch is the largest automotive supplier in the world.

BASF SE.company_description: BASF SE is a European multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. It operates in more than 80 countries and supplies products to a wide variety of industries. BASF has subsidiaries and joint ventures across the globe and is headquartered in Ludwigshafen, Germany. The company began as a dye manufacturer in 1865 and has since grown rapidly. BASF is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, London Stock Exchange, and Zurich Stock Exchange.

Rewe Group.company_description: The REWE Group is a German diversified retail and tourism co-operative group based in Cologne, Germany. It operates as a supermarket chain, with Rewe being its main brand. Rewe is the second largest food retailer in Germany, with about 3,300 stores. The company offers a range of products under various store brand names, including 'ja!' for discount-priced items, 'REWE Beste Wahl' for normal-priced items, 'REWE Feine Welt' for high-priced and special items, 'REWE Bio' for organic products, 'REWE Bio + vegan' for organic and vegan products, 'REWE frei von' for allergen-free products, 'REWE Regional' for regional products, and 'REWE to go' for convenience items. Rewe is also known for its online grocery delivery service, which was launched in 2011 and gradually expanded throughout Germany.

Innogy SE.company_description: Innogy SE was an energy company based in Essen, Germany. It has now merged and integrated into German energy company E.ON. Npower, a subsidiary of Innogy, is a British supplier of gas and electricity to businesses and is now part of E.ON UK. RWE, another energy company, completed an asset swap deal with E.ON, transferring the international renewable generation portfolio of E.ON and Innogy to RWE.

Siemens AG.company_description: Siemens AG is a German multinational technology conglomerate. It operates in various sectors, including automation and digitalization in the process and manufacturing industries, intelligent infrastructure for buildings and distributed energy systems, rail transport solutions, health technology, and digital healthcare services. Siemens is the largest industrial manufacturing company in Europe and a global market leader in industrial automation and industrial software. The company has several divisions, including Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Healthineers, and Financial Services. Siemens Healthineers is a subsidiary that provides healthcare solutions and services, while Siemens Energy is a separate entity focused on energy solutions.

EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG.company_description: EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG is the largest German supermarket corporation, consisting of several co-operatives of independent supermarkets. It operates approximately 4,100 stores under the Edeka nameplate, ranging from small corner stores to hypermarkets. The company also acquired Tengelmann's Plus discounter store division, which was merged into Edeka's Netto brand. EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG is headquartered in Hamburg and operates as the central financing institute for Edeka grocery retailers.

Audi AG.company_description: Audi AG is a German automotive manufacturer of luxury vehicles. It operates in the automotive industry and produces vehicles in nine production facilities worldwide. Audi is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and is known for its luxury and high-performance vehicles. The company offers a range of models, including sedans, SUVs, coupes, and electric vehicles. Some notable models include the Audi A3, A4, A6, Q5, Q7, and the all-electric Audi e-tron. Audi is recognized for its advanced technology, innovative design, and the use of quattro all-wheel drive system in many of its vehicles.

Deutsche Bahn AG.company_description: Deutsche Bahn AG is the national railway company of Germany and a state-owned enterprise. It is the largest railway operator and infrastructure owner in Europe. The company operates in various sectors, including long-distance passenger services (DB Fernverkehr), local passenger services (DB Regio), and rail freight transport (DB Cargo). Deutsche Bahn also operates a large part of the German railway infrastructure through its subsidiary DB Netz. The company generates revenue from operating rail transport, as well as from transport and logistics businesses and service providers. It is headquartered in Berlin and is considered one of the largest transport companies in the world.

EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG.company_description: EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG is a publicly-traded energy company headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany. It operates in the energy sector and is based in the German state of Baden-Württemberg EnBW offers a range of products and services related to energy generation, transmission, and distribution. This includes electricity and gas supply, renewable energy solutions, energy trading, and energy services.

Daimler Truck Holding AG.company_description: Daimler Truck Holding AG, also known as Daimler Truck AG, is one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It operates in various locations worldwide and has approximately 100,000 employees. Daimler Truck AG was previously a part of Daimler AG and was spun off as an independent company in December 2021. The company is headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany. Daimler Truck AG offers a range of commercial vehicles, including trucks and buses, under various brands such as Mercedes-Benz, Freightliner, and FUSO.

Bayer AG.company_description: Bayer AG is a German multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company. It operates in the areas of pharmaceuticals, consumer healthcare products, agricultural chemicals, seeds, and biotechnology products.

BP Europa SE.company_description: BP Europa SE is a European joint-stock company of the BP group. It was established in 2010 through the merger of BP companies in Belgium, the Netherlands, Austria, and Poland with the German Deutsche BP AG. The company is registered in Hamburg, Germany, with its administrative headquarters located in Bochum. BP Europa SE is primarily engaged in the sale of fuels and operates in the energy sector. It is a part of BP's efforts in the green hydrogen production value chain, including conversion into derivatives like ammonia and transport. BP Europa SE also collaborates with Lekkerland SE to deliver REWE To Go stores at Aral retail sites in Germany.

ZF Friedrichshafen AG.company_description: ZF Friedrichshafen AG, also known as ZF Group, is a global technology company specializing in engineering, research and development, and manufacturing activities in the automotive industry. It supplies systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial technology. ZF Friedrichshafen offers driveline and chassis technology for cars and commercial vehicles, as well as specialist plant equipment such as construction equipment. It is also involved in the rail, marine, defense, and aviation industries, as well as general industrial applications. The company has 168 production locations in 32 countries and employs approximately 165,000 people.

Abbott Holding GmbH.company_description: Abbott Holding GmbH specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical and medical products. They offer a range of products including diagnostic systems and instruments, vascular devices, and more.

ThyssenKrupp AG.company_description: ThyssenKrupp AG is a German industrial engineering and steel production multinational conglomerate. It offers a range of products including machines, industrial services, high-speed trains, elevators, shipbuilding, and naval vessels such as frigates, corvettes, and submarines.

Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA.company_description: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a European multinational health care company based in Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany. It provides products and services for dialysis in hospitals, as well as inpatient and outpatient medical care. The company is involved in hospital management and in engineering and services for medical centers and other health care facilities. Additionally, Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA, a subsidiary of Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA, specializes in providing kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient dialysis centers worldwide.

Traton SE.company_description: Traton SE, formerly known as Volkswagen Truck & Bus AG, is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It operates through its brands MAN, Scania, Navistar, and Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus. Traton offers a range of products including light-, medium-, and heavy-duty trucks, vans, and buses. As of 2020, Traton employed around 82,600 people in its commercial vehicle brands.

Continental AG.company_description: Continental AG is a German multinational automotive parts manufacturing company. It specializes in tires, brake systems, vehicle electronics, automotive safety, powertrain, chassis components, tachographs, and other parts for the automotive and transportation industries. Continental operates in six divisions: Chassis and Safety, Powertrain, Interior, Tires, ContiTech, and ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems). It is one of the world's largest automotive suppliers and the fourth-largest tire manufacturer. Continental sells tires under the Continental brand and other select distribution brands such as Viking, General Tire, Gislaved Tires, Semperit Tyres, Barum, Uniroyal, Sportiva, Mabor, Matador, and formerly Sime/Simex tyres. Its customers include major automobile, truck, and bus producers worldwide.

RWE AG.company_description: RWE AG is a German multinational energy company headquartered in Essen. It generates and trades electricity in the Asia-Pacific region, Europe, and the United States. The company is the world's second-largest offshore wind power generation and Europe's third-largest company in renewable energy. RWE AG operates in the energy sector and offers a range of products and services related to electricity generation and trading.

Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG.company_name: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG.company_description: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG, commonly known as Porsche, is a German automobile manufacturer specializing in high-performance sports cars, SUVs, and sedans. The company is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany and is owned by Volkswagen AG. Porsche's current lineup includes models such as the 718, 911, Panamera, Macan, Cayenne, and Taycan.

Phoenix Pharma SE.company_description: PHOENIX Pharma SE is the European leader in pharmaceutical wholesale, pharmacy retail, and services for the pharmaceutical industry. They supply pharmacies, doctors, and medical facilities with medicines and healthcare products across 29 countries through more than 224 sites.

VNG AG.company_description: VNG AG is a group of over 20 companies headquartered in Leipzig, Germany. It serves to ensure the secure supply of gas in Germany as the country's third-largest gas importer and storage operator. VNG AG operates through its subsidiary ONTRAS Gastransport GmbH, which is the operator of a 7,700 km network of long-distance gas pipelines. Additionally, VNG AG collaborates with other companies, such as Aker Horizons ASA and Yara Clean Ammonia, to explore opportunities in the field of green ammonia and clean ammonia production.

Hapag-Lloyd AG.company_description: Hapag-Lloyd AG is a German international shipping and container transportation company. It was formed in 1970 through a merger of Hamburg-American Line (HAPAG) and Norddeutscher Lloyd. Hapag-Lloyd operates in the shipping and logistics industry, offering services for container shipping, port-to-port transportation, and door-to-door logistics solutions.

Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH.company_description: Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH is a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell plc and operates in the oil and gas industry in Germany. The company is involved in the production, refining, and distribution of petroleum products. Shell Deutschland Oil GmbH offers a range of products including gasoline, diesel, heating oil, lubricants, and bitumen. They also provide services such as fuel cards and convenience store offerings at their retail locations.

Deutsche Lufthansa AG.company_description: Deutsche Lufthansa AG, commonly known as Lufthansa, is the flag carrier of Germany. It is the second-largest airline in Europe in terms of passengers carried. Lufthansa is a founding member of the Star Alliance, the world's largest airline alliance. In addition to its own services, Lufthansa owns subsidiary passenger airlines such as Austrian Airlines, Swiss International Air Lines, Brussels Airlines, and Eurowings. The company also owns aviation-related companies like Lufthansa Technik and LSG Sky Chefs. Lufthansa has a fleet of over 700 aircraft and its main operations base is at Frankfurt Airport. The company was founded in 1953 and has its headquarters in Cologne.

Amazon Deutschland.company_description: Amazon Deutschland is a leading e-retailer in Germany, offering a wide range of products and services. They operate in the retail trade and provide software, logistics, and e-commerce solutions. Amazon Deutschland is known for its expedited delivery services and has a significant presence in the German market.

SAP SE.company_description: SAP SE is a German multinational software company based in Walldorf, Baden-Württemberg. It develops enterprise software to manage business operations and customer relations. SAP is the world's leading enterprise resource planning (ERP) software vendor and the largest non-American software company by revenue. In addition to ERP software, SAP also sells database software, cloud-engineered systems, and other ERP software products for various business functions.

Linde AG.company_description: Linde AG is a global multinational chemical company that is the world's largest industrial gas company by market share and revenue. It operates in various industries including healthcare, petroleum refining, manufacturing, food and beverage, steel making, aerospace, and more. Linde's primary business is the manufacturing and distribution of atmospheric gases, process gases, and specialty gases. The company was formed in 2018 through the merger of Linde AG of Germany and Praxair of the United States.

Derpart Reisevertrieb GmbH.company_description: Derpart Reisevertrieb GmbH is a travel agency partner system in Germany. It has over 290 travel agencies, including more than 60 DERPART Travel Service centers specializing in the business travel sector. They offer services such as Zugbegleiter-Service, event management, and hotel procurement.

Thüga AG.company_description: Thüga AG is a German energy company that operates in the regional energy supply sector. It provides electricity, gas, heat, and water to approximately one million people in Hessen and neighboring provinces.

Metro AG.company_description: Metro AG is a German multinational company that operates business membership-only cash and carry stores primarily under the Metro brand. It operates around 661 stores in 31 countries in Europe and Asia. Metro AG was established in 1964 and was the fourth-largest retailer in the world by revenues in 2010. It was spun off from the old Metro AG in 2017 and continues to be a prominent player in the retail industry.

Vattenfall GmbH.company_description: Vattenfall GmbH is a multinational power company based in Germany. It operates in various areas, including nuclear energy and transmission systems. Vattenfall Europe Nuclear Energy GmbH is a subsidiary of Vattenfall that owns and operates nuclear power plants in Germany. These include the Brunsbüttel Nuclear Power Plant, Krümmel Nuclear Power Plant, and Brokdorf Nuclear Power Plant. Vattenfall GmbH also owns 50Hertz Transmission GmbH, which is one of the transmission system operators for electricity in Germany. Additionally, Vattenfall Nederland B.V., formerly known as N.V. Nuon Energy, is a utility company based in the Netherlands that provides electricity, natural gas, and heat. Please note that this information was obtained from external sources.

Heraeus Holding GmbH.company_description: Heraeus Holding GmbH is a German technology group with a focus on precious and special metals, medical technology, quartz glass, sensors and specialty light sources as well as electronic components. It is one of the largest family-owned companies in Germany in terms of revenue. Heraeus employs 17,200 people in 40 countries and generated a total revenue of €29.1 billion in 2022. The company's headquarters and head office are located in Hanau, Germany.

Siemens Energy AG.company_description: Siemens Energy AG is an energy company formed through the spin-off of the former Gas and Power division of Siemens. It operates in the areas of automation and digitalization in the process and manufacturing industries, intelligent infrastructure for buildings and distributed energy systems, rail transport solutions, as well as health technology and digital healthcare services. Siemens Energy AG offers a wide range of products including gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, transformers, and grid solutions.

Schenker Deutschland AG.company_description: Schenker Deutschland AG is a division of DB Schenker, which is a logistics company under the umbrella of Deutsche Bahn. DB Schenker offers a wide range of logistics services, including air, land, and sea freight, as well as contract logistics. It operates globally and provides transportation and logistics solutions for various industries. DB Schenker is known for its expertise in supply chain management and offers customized solutions to meet the specific needs of its customers.

Kaufland Stiftung & Co. KG.company_description: Kaufland Stiftung & Co. KG is a food production company that specializes in the manufacture of own-brand goods for the supermarket chains Lidl and Kaufland. They also produce a limited quantity of goods for third parties. Their operations include the reuse, recycling, and production of new plastic bottles for beverage filling. Kaufland Stiftung & Co. KG is headquartered in Germany and is part of the Schwarz Gruppe. They provide customer insight and operate in the food industry.

Baywa AG.company_description: BayWa AG is an internationally active group headquartered in Munich, Germany. Originally founded to support domestic agriculture, the company expanded its activities to the construction and energy sectors. BayWa is represented in more than 50 countries through its subsidiaries and holdings. The shareholder structure is still determined by the cooperative sector, which has shaped the corporate culture since its founding.

Aldi Einkauf GmbH & Co. oHG (Nord).company_description: Aldi Einkauf GmbH & Co. oHG (Nord) is a German multinational discount supermarket chain. It is part of Aldi Nord, which operates over 2,200 stores in western, northern, and eastern Germany. Aldi Nord also operates internationally in countries such as Belgium, Denmark, France, Luxembourg, Poland, Portugal, and Spain. The company offers a wide range of products including groceries, household items, electronics, and more.

Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG.company_description: Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG is a division of Mercedes-Benz Group AG, which includes the vehicle manufacturer Mercedes-Benz AG. They are one of the largest suppliers of premium and luxury passenger cars and vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility focuses on sustainable mobility and offers environmentally friendly charging solutions for electric vehicles, using 100% renewable electricity within their charging network.

Hochtief AG.company_description: Hochtief AG is a German construction company based in Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is Germany's largest construction company and operates globally. Hochtief is involved in construction project planning, finance, construction, and operation. It has divisions such as Hochtief Concessions, which is a major airport operator. The company has a rich history dating back to 1874 and has been involved in notable engineering and infrastructure projects worldwide. Some of its projects include the transplantation of the Abu Simbel rock temples in Egypt, the new Athens International Airport, and Germany's first nuclear power plant. Hochtief AG is also known for its involvement with the Bauhaus movement and its work on World Heritage Sites. In recent years, Hochtief AG has been majority-owned by Spanish construction company ACS Group.

Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. K.company_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. K.company_description: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG is a subsidiary of Boehringer Ingelheim, one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies. It operates globally and focuses on respiratory diseases, metabolism, immunology, oncology, and diseases of the central nervous system. Boehringer Ingelheim is a private company and is fully owned by the Boehringer, Liebrecht, and von Baumbach families.

Volkswagen Leasing GmbH.company_description: Volkswagen Leasing GmbH is a subsidiary of Volkswagen Financial Services AG. It operates in the area of company bike leasing and offers leasing services for bicycles. Volkswagen Financial Services has acquired a 49 percent stake in the Pon bike leasing subsidiary Bike Mobility Services (BMS) to strengthen its partnership with Pon Holdings in this area.

Adidas AG.company_description: Adidas AG is a German athletic apparel and footwear corporation. It is the largest sportswear manufacturer in Europe and the second largest in the world. Adidas operates in the area of athletic apparel and footwear, offering a wide range of products including shoes, clothing, and accessories for various sports and activities.

Henkel AG & Co. KGaA.company_description: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company. It operates in two globally operating business units: Consumer Brands and Adhesive Technologies. Henkel is known for brands such as Loctite, Persil, Fa, Pritt, Dial, and Purex, among others. In the fiscal year 2022, Henkel reported sales of around 22 billion euros and an operating profit of 1.810 billion euros. The company has approximately 51,950 employees, with 85% working outside of Germany.

Merck KGaA.company_description: Merck KGaA is a German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt. It operates in the areas of healthcare, life sciences, and electronics. The company has a presence in 66 countries and includes around 250 companies. Merck KGaA is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company and is listed on the DAX index. It has major research and development centers in Darmstadt, Boston, Tokyo, and Beijing. The company is known for its pioneering work in the commercial manufacture of morphine and its ownership of the Merck brand outside of the U.S. and Canada.

Media-Saturn-Holding GmbH.company_description: Media-Saturn-Holding GmbH is a company that operates in the trade and distribution of electrical goods, particularly consumer electronics, household appliances, tools, books, toys, and photo articles. They also provide services such as installation and repair. Media-Saturn-Holding GmbH is a subsidiary of Ceconomy AG.

Ceconomy AG.company_description: Ceconomy AG is an international retail company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. It operates more than 1,000 consumer electronics stores in twelve countries, including MediaMarkt and Saturn. Ceconomy also owns Deutsche Technikberatung. Approximately 32.5% of its sales are generated online.

Siemens Healthineers AG.company_description: Siemens Healthineers AG is a German company that provides healthcare solutions and services. It was spun off from its parent company Siemens in 2017 and is headquartered in Erlangen, Germany. Siemens Healthineers is the parent company for several medical technology companies and operates in the field of medical technology. They offer a range of products and services in areas such as diagnostic imaging, laboratory diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, and more.

Bertelsmann SE & Co. KGaA.company_description: Bertelsmann SE & Co. KGaA is a German private multinational conglomerate corporation based in Gütersloh, Germany. It is one of the world's largest media conglomerates and operates in the media, service, and education sectors. Its divisions include the RTL Group, Penguin Random House, BMG, Arvato, Bertelsmann Printing Group, Bertelsmann Education Group, and Bertelsmann Investments.

Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG is a worldwide wholesaler of fasteners, screws and screw accessories, dowels, chemicals, electronic and electromechanical components, furniture and construction fittings, tools, machines, installation material, automotive hardware, inventory management, storage and retrieval systems. They serve industries such as Automotive, Woodworking, Metalworking, Industrial, and Construction. The company was founded in 1945 by Adolf Würth GmbH & Co. KG and is currently led by his son Reinhold Würth.

Brenntag SE.company_description: Brenntag SE is the global market leader in chemicals and ingredients distribution. They connect customers and suppliers in the chemical industry and offer a wide range of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients. They also provide services such as storage, processing, logistics management, and technical support. Brenntag operates through its two divisions, Brenntag Specialties and Brenntag Essentials, and is known for its comprehensive portfolio and expertise in the field.

Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA.company_name: Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA
Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA.company_description: Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA is a German healthcare company that specializes in providing kidney dialysis services. They operate a network of outpatient dialysis centers and serve a large number of patients with end-stage renal disease. With headquarters in Germany and the United States, they have a significant market share in the dialysis market. In addition to dialysis services, Fresenius Medical Care also operates production sites and is involved in hospital management and engineering services for medical centers.

HeidelbergCement AG.company_description: HeidelbergCement AG, now known as Heidelberg Materials, is a German multinational building materials company and a DAX corporation. It is one of the world's largest building materials companies, with activities in around 60 countries and 57,000 employees. The company operates 139 cement plants, more than 1,500 ready-mixed concrete production sites, and over 600 aggregates quarries. It completed the acquisition of a 45% shareholding in Italcementi in 2016, making it the number one producer of construction aggregates, the second-largest in cement, and the third-largest in ready-mixed concrete worldwide.

Wintershall Dea AG.company_description: Wintershall Dea AG is the result of the merger of Wintershall Holding GmbH and DEA Deutsche Erdoel AG, forming Europe's leading independent natural gas and oil company. The company focuses on exploration and production (E&P) and has a strong emphasis on digitalization and technology to drive excellence in its operations. Wintershall Dea has achieved solid operational performance, with a daily quarterly production of 324,000 barrels of oil equivalent (boe) and has successfully produced the first gas at the ED2-X well at East Damanhur block in the onshore Nile Delta in Egypt.

Aurubis AG.company_description: Aurubis AG is a global supplier of non-ferrous metals and one of the world's largest copper recyclers. The company processes complex metal concentrates, scrap, organic and inorganic metal-bearing recycling materials and industrial residues into metals. Aurubis produces more than 1 million tons of copper cathodes per year and from these a variety of products such as wire rod, continuous cast shapes, profiles and flat rolled products in copper and copper alloys. The company also produces a range of other metals, including precious metals such as selenium, lead, nickel, tin, and zinc. Additionally, the portfolio includes products such as sulfuric acid and iron silicate. Aurubis has about 6,900 employees, production sites in Europe and the USA, and a worldwide sales network. The company's shares are listed in the Prime Standard Segment of the German Stock Exchange and in the MDAX, the Global Challenges Index (GCX), and the STOXX Europe 600.

Evonik Industries AG.company_description: Evonik Industries AG is a publicly-listed German specialty chemicals company headquartered in Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is the second-largest chemicals company in Germany, and one of the largest specialty chemicals companies in the world. The company's specialty chemicals business generates around 80% of its sales, and it operates in more than 100 countries. Evonik Industries employs about 37,000 people and its operating activities are organized into six business units within the chemicals business area.

Covestro AG.company_description: Covestro AG is a German company producing polyurethane and polycarbonate raw materials. Its products include isocyanates and polyols for cellular foams, thermoplastic polyurethane and polycarbonate pellets, as well as polyurethane-based additives used in the formulation of coatings and adhesives. The main industries served are automotive manufacturing and supply, electrical engineering and electronics, construction and home products, and sports and leisure. Their products include coatings and adhesives, polyurethanes used in thermal insulation, electrical housings, and as a component of footwear and mattresses, and polycarbonates such as Covestro's Makrolon, which are highly impact-resistant plastics.

Aldi Einkauf GmbH & Co. oHG (Süd).company_description: Aldi is the common company brand name of two German multinational family-owned discount supermarket chains operating over 12,000 stores in 19 countries. The chain was founded by brothers Karl and Theo Albrecht in 1946, when they took over their mother's store in Essen. The business was split into two separate groups in 1960, that later became Aldi Nord, headquartered in Essen, and Aldi Süd, headquartered in Mülheim. Aldi's German operations consist of Aldi Nord's 35 individual regional companies with about 2,200 stores in western, northern, and eastern Germany, and Aldi Süd's 32 regional companies with 2,000 stores in western and southern Germany. Internationally, Aldi Nord operates in Belgium, Denmark, France, Luxembourg, Poland, Portugal and Spain, while Aldi Süd operates in Australia, Austria, China, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Slovenia, Switzerland, United Kingdom and United States. Only in Austria and Slovenia Aldi operates the stores under the Hofer brand. Aldi Nord also owns the Trader Joe's grocery chain in the United States which operates separately from the group. Aldi Süd announced in August 2023 that it will buy 400 Winn-Dixie and Harveys supermarkets in the southern United States.

Biontech SE.company_description: BioNTech SE is a German biotechnology company that develops and manufactures active immunotherapies for patient-specific approaches to the treatment of diseases. It focuses on developing pharmaceutical candidates based on messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) for individualized cancer immunotherapies, vaccines against infectious diseases, and protein replacement therapies for rare diseases. The company has also developed an mRNA-based human therapeutic for intravenous administration and has collaborated with Pfizer to develop the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, which has been authorized for use in preventing COVID-19 infections.

Total Energies Holding Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Total Energies Holding Deutschland GmbH operates in trading and sea transport of crude oil and oil products, petroleum products distribution, and electricity generation from combined cycle gas plants and renewable energies. The company is also pursuing growth in the renewable energy sector and has a focus on climate change-related challenges, people's well-being, and care for the environment. Additionally, TotalEnergies has been awarded marine concessions by the German Federal Network Agency.

Eurofactor GmbH.company_description: Eurofactor GmbH is a company with operations in 11 countries in Europe and the Maghreb, offering factoring services and having a wide distribution network through the banking networks of the Crédit Agricole group.

Exxon Mobil Central Europe Holding GmbH.company_name: Exxon Mobil Central Europe Holding GmbH
Exxon Mobil Central Europe Holding GmbH.company_description: ExxonMobil Central Europe Holding GmbH is involved in energy provision and chemical manufacturing, and it develops and applies next-generation technologies to meet energy needs.

Tennet TSO GmbH.company_description: TenneT TSO GmbH, a subsidiary of TenneT B.V., is a transmission system operator in Germany responsible for overseeing the operation of the high-voltage grid and interconnections with neighboring countries. It operates 3,286 km of lines and cables at 150 kV and above, connecting at 51 high-voltage substations. The company plays a significant role in the electricity sector in Germany, particularly in the context of the country's transition to renewable energy sources.

TUI AG.company_description: TUI Group is a German leisure, travel, and tourism company, with activities involving the operation of hotels, cruise ships, and airlines. It fully or partially owns several travel agencies, hotel chains, cruise lines, and retail shops, as well as five European airlines. TUI Group is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange.

Otto Group.company_description: Otto Group, also known as Otto GmbH & Co KG, is a German mail order and e-commerce company, operating in more than twenty countries. It primarily focuses on retail e-commerce and also operates in e-commerce services, real estate, and financial services. The company has expanded into various sectors and has a significant presence in the European market.

BSH Hausgeräte GmbH.company_description: BSH Hausgeräte GmbH is the largest manufacturer of home appliances in Europe and one of the leading companies in the sector worldwide. It operates some 39 factories in Europe, the USA, Latin America, and Asia, with a global network of sales, production, and service companies. The product range includes large home appliances for cooking, dish-washing, laundry, refrigeration, and freezing, as well as small appliances such as fully automatic espresso machines, floor care, and hot water appliances.

Schaeffler AG.company_description: Schaeffler Group, also known as Schaeffler Technologies AG & Co. KG, is a German manufacturer of rolling element bearings for automotive, aerospace, and industrial uses. It was founded in 1946 and is currently majority owned by Maria-Elizabeth Schaeffler-Thumann and her son Georg F. W. Schaeffler. The firm owns the brands INA, FAG, and LuK, and has an Indian subsidiary, Schaeffler India, which is publicly listed on the National Stock Exchange of India and the Bombay Stock Exchange.

Knauf Gips KG.company_description: Knauf Gips KG is a multinational, family-owned company based in Iphofen, Germany. It is well known for drywall gypsum boards and is a producer of building materials and construction systems, including construction materials for drywall construction, plasterboard, cement boards, mineral fibre acoustic boards, dry mortars, insulating materials, and insulation materials under the company Knauf Insulation. The company has more than 150 production sites worldwide and is one of the major producers in the worldwide wallboard market.

Ford-Werke GmbH.company_description: Ford-Werke GmbH is a German-based car manufacturing factory headquartered in Niehl, Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia. It is a fully owned subsidiary of American Ford Motor Company, which operates two large manufacturing facilities in Germany, a plant in Cologne and a plant in Saarlouis and serves as a major hub for the Automaker's presence in the European markets.

Infineon Technologies AG.company_description: Infineon Technologies AG is Germany's largest semiconductor manufacturer, with about 50,280 employees and sales of €11.06 billion in 2021. The company operates in around 60 countries and offers a wide range of semiconductor products used in various applications including lighting, automobile, satellite, aircraft, and defense systems, as well as key components in power supply systems in electronics-based products.

Lekkerland SE & Co. KG.company_description: Lekkerland SE & Co. KG is a trading company and the exclusive supply partner for the majority of the product ranges stocked in stores across Aral's network of 1,200 company-owned retail sites in Germany. It is part of the REWE group and offers innovative services, tailor-made logistics, and a wide range of wholesale products to customers in four European countries.

Trianel GmbH.company_description: Trianel GmbH is an offshore wind service company headquartered in Bremerhaven, Germany. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Siemens Gamesa. The company is involved in designing, assembling, and installing wind turbines for offshore wind farms, as well as manufacturing rotor blades through its subsidiary Adwen Blades GmbH.

Lufthansa AirPlus Servicekarten GmbH.company_description: Lufthansa AirPlus Servicekarten GmbH has been sold to SEB Kort Bank AB, a leading corporate payment solutions provider in the Nordics and wholly owned subsidiary of SEB Group, for around 450 million euros. The sale includes all international subsidiaries and branches of AirPlus.

Droege Group AG.company_description: Droege Group AG, founded by Walter P.J. Droege, operates in the areas of restructuring and turnaround advisory services. The company is based in Düsseldorf, Germany. Additionally, the Droege Group AG is associated with ALSO Holding AG, a distribution and logistics company based in Switzerland, and HAL Allergy Group, a pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy diagnostic and allergen immunotherapy products.

Opel Automobile GmbH.company_description: Opel Automobile GmbH, usually shortened to Opel, is a German automobile manufacturer which has been a subsidiary of Stellantis since 16 January 2021. It designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes Opel-branded passenger vehicles, light commercial vehicles, and vehicle parts; together with its British sister marque Vauxhall, they are present in over 60 countries around the world.

dm-drogerie markt GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: dm-drogerie markt (usually abbreviated as dm) is a chain of retail stores headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, offering cosmetics, healthcare items, household products and health food and drinks. The company was founded in 1973 and is known for its flat hierarchical structures and high level of social commitment. It is Germany's largest retailer measured by revenues and has more than 62,600 employees in more than 3,700 stores in twelve European countries.

Netto Marken-Discount AG & Co. KG.company_description: Netto Marken-Discount (also known as just Netto, formerly Plus) is a German discount supermarket chain owned by the German supermarket cooperative Edeka Group, and operates mostly in the south and west of Germany. The company reached its 1000th store in 2004, then aggressively expanded to the 4000th store in 2009, making it the largest discounter in Germany.

Gazprom Germania GmbH.company_description: Gazprom Germania GmbH is a former subsidiary of Gazprom, Russia's state-owned natural gas monopoly, which was nationalized by the German government to maintain the country's energy security. The company, previously known as Gazprom Germania, operated as Securing Energy for Europe GmbH (SEFE) until June. The nationalization was intended to safeguard Germany's energy security and ensure the continuation of business operations.

Remondis SE & Co. KG.company_description: Remondis SE & Co. KG is a German multinational company specializing in recycling, water resource management, and industrial and communal services. It operates in over 800 locations in more than 30 countries, with more than 30,000 employees and an estimated revenue of 6.4 billion Euro in 2018. Remondis is part of the Rethmann Group.

Liebherr-International Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Liebherr-International Deutschland GmbH is a German company that operates in the manufacturing of heavy equipment and machinery, including off-highway haul trucks and other industrial equipment. It is also involved in providing equipment to the German Army. Additionally, Liebherr-International Deutschland GmbH is part of the Liebherr Group, which is known for its diverse range of products including construction machinery, mining equipment, aerospace components, and more.

Salzgitter AG.company_description: Salzgitter AG is a German company, one of the largest steel producers in Europe with an annual output of around seven million tonnes. With over 100 subsidiaries and associated companies, the Group is structured in five divisions – Steel, Trading, Tubes, Services and Technology – under the umbrella of a management holding company.

Mahle GmbH.company_description: Mahle GmbH is a German automotive parts manufacturer based in Stuttgart, Germany. It is one of the largest automotive suppliers worldwide, specializing in components and systems for the combustion engine and its periphery. The company is one of the three largest systems suppliers worldwide for engine systems, filtration, electrics, mechatronics, and thermal management. In 2018, Mahle's sales amounted to over €12.5 billion. The company has approximately 72,000 employees working in 152 production plants and 12 major research and development centers in various countries.

Penny-Markt GmbH.company_description: Penny-Markt GmbH, operating in several European countries, is a leading discount store chain with a focus on offering fresh, top-quality produce and locally sourced products where possible. The company is actively involved in political discussions related to wholesale/retail trade, food, sustainability, business, digitalization, and tourism.

Strabag AG.company_description: STRABAG SE is an Austrian construction company that is the largest construction company in Austria and one of the largest in Europe. It operates in Austria, Germany, Central, Eastern, and South-East Europe, as well as in selected markets in Western Europe, the Arabian Peninsula, Canada, Chile, China, and India. The company is involved in construction projects and operates subsidiaries in various countries.

Dirk Rossmann GmbH.company_description: Dirk Rossmann GmbH, commonly referred to as Rossmann, is one of the largest drug store chains in Europe with around 56,200 employees and more than 4000 stores. In 2019, Rossmann had more than €10 billion turnover in Germany, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Turkey, Albania, Kosovo, Israel, and Spain. The company offers a wide range of products including drugstore goods, skin, hair, body, baby and health products, promotional items, pet food, a photo service, natural foods, wines, and a perfume range with around 200 commercial brands. Rossmann has 29 private brands with 4600 products, and the best-known brands include Isana, Alterra, domol, and alouette. The company logo consists of a red name and the symbol of a centaur integrated in the letter O. Since 2018, Rossmann has been publishing a sustainability report for the development of corporate climate protection activities. In 2021, sales increased by 8.1 percent to 11.1 billion euros. There are a total of 4,361 Rossmann branches, 2,231 of which are in Germany, and the current number of foreign branches is: Poland (1580), Hungary (more than 230), Czech Republic (more than 150), Turkey (more than 120), Albania (15), Kosovo (6), and Spain (5).

Amprion GmbH.company_description: Amprion GmbH, formerly RWE Transportnetz Strom GmbH, is one of the four transmission system operators for electricity in Germany with approximately 2300 employees. It is a member of European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E).

Freudenberg SE.company_description: The Freudenberg Group is a German family-owned diversified group of companies with products including housewares, cleaning products, automobile parts, textiles, building materials, and telecommunications. It has production facilities in Europe, Asia, Australia, South and North America. The parent company was founded in 1849 as a producer of leather goods and is currently owned by descendants of the original founder.

Helios Kliniken GmbH.company_description: Helios Kliniken GmbH is a European multinational healthcare company based in Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany. It provides products and services for dialysis in hospitals, as well as inpatient and outpatient medical care. The company is involved in hospital management and in engineering and services for medical centers and other healthcare facilities. It is also ranked 411th in the Forbes Global 2000 list in 2023. In addition, the company has announced plans to merge with InterWell Health and Cricket Health to form a new company focused on services for the earlier stages of kidney disease.

Vodafone GmbH.company_description: Vodafone GmbH is a mobile telecommunications operator in Germany headquartered in Düsseldorf. It provides mobile phone, LTE, 5G, cable internet, landlines, cable TV, and IPTV services. As of the third quarter of 2021, Vodafone GmbH has more than 31 million mobile customers in Germany, making it the third-largest provider of mobile phone services in Germany. The company's headquarters are in the suburb of Heerdt in Düsseldorf, with regional offices throughout Germany. Vodafone Germany's main competitors are Telekom Deutschland (Deutsche Telekom's German private customer unit) and Telefónica Germany. Vodafone Germany's network serves both prepaid and postpaid customers on GSM and LTE (Long Term Evolution). In July 2019, Vodafone started providing 5G services. At the end of 2010, Vodafone had 36.676 million mobile phone or mobile internet customers and 3.945 million customers with a DSL / VDSL connection.

MAN Truck & Bus SE.company_description: MAN Truck & Bus SE is a subsidiary of Traton and is one of the leading international providers of commercial vehicles. It produces vans, trucks, heavy goods vehicles, bus-chassis, coaches, interurban coaches, city buses, and diesel and natural-gas engines.

Kion Group AG.company_description: Kion Group AG (styled as KION Group) is a German multinational manufacturer of materials handling equipment, with its headquarters in Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany. Its principal products are intralogistics, warehouse automation equipment, and industrial (forklift) trucks. KION Group was founded in 2006 by the demerger of Linde's materials handling equipment operations. It is the world's second-largest manufacturer of forklifts measured by revenues (after Toyota Industries).

Stadtwerke Köln GmbH.company_description: Stadtwerke Köln GmbH is the infrastructure and services company of the City of Cologne. The company undertakes water supply and electrical, gas, heat and steam energy supply through the subsidiary RheinEnergie. Other subsidiaries provide waste management and housing services for the city, in addition to operating the public baths. The subsidiaries Kölner Verkehrs-Betriebe (KVB) and Häfen und Güterverkehr Köln (HGK) operate the city's urban and industrial transportation systems respectively.

SüdFactoring GmbH.company_description: SüdFactoring GmbH is a company that offers products related to commercial and industrial energy systems, including energy storage system offerings. It is also involved in the development and supply of high pressure alkaline electrolyzers, with a new 500 MW manufacturing capacity in Texas.

maxingvest AG.company_description: maxingvest AG is the holding company for Tchibo and Beiersdorf. It holds a 100% stake in Tchibo GmbH and controls more than 50% of the voting rights of Beiersdorf AG. The company specializes in the development, production, and marketing of cosmetic products.

MAN SE.company_description: MAN SE was a manufacturing and engineering company based in Munich, Germany. Its primary output was commercial vehicles and diesel engines through its MAN Truck & Bus and MAN Latin America divisions. MAN SE was majority-owned by Traton, the heavy commercial vehicle subsidiary of automaker Volkswagen AG, until August 2021 when Traton completed a squeeze out of all remaining shareholders and formally merged MAN SE into Traton SE, meaning the former subsidiaries of MAN SE were now directly owned by Traton, and MAN SE ceased to exist.

Stadtwerke München GmbH.company_description: Stadtwerke München GmbH (Munich City Utilities) or SWM is a German communal company, owned by the city of Munich, which offers public services for the city and the region of Munich. The company supplies electricity for more than 95% of Munich's 750.000 households as well as natural gas, drinking water and, through its stake in the M-net Telekommunikations GmbH, telecommunications services. SWM is Europe's largest municipal utility company and ranks among Germany's principal energy providers according to company information. Expanding use of renewable energy has been a central element in the company's strategy since 2008. However, the company is also engaged in the industrialisation of the Norwegian wilderness through massive wind-turbines, which has created great opposition in Norway, among others in Sørmarka, Trøndelag. Through its subsidiary, the Münchner Verkehrsgesellschaft mbH (MVG) (founded in 2001), the SWM also runs most of the inner city public transportation network by maintaining the Munich U-Bahn as well as the Munich Tramway and bus services.

Zalando SE.company_description: Zalando SE is a publicly traded German online retailer of shoes, fashion, and beauty active across Europe. The company was founded in 2008 by David Schneider and Robert Gentz and has more than 51 million active users in 25 European markets. Zalando is active in a variety of business fields - from multi-brand online shopping (including their own brands), the shopping club Lounge by Zalando, outlets in 12 German cities, as well as logistics and marketing offers for retailers. In 2022, Zalando generated revenue of 10.3 billion Euro, with roughly 16,000 employees.

RWE Vertrieb AG.company_description: RWE Vertrieb AG is one of the leading European energy groups, offering products and services in electricity and gas trading and distribution, including physical and derivative forms of oil, CO2 certificates, and biomass-based renewables.

Airbus Defence and Space.company_description: Airbus Defense and Space is the division of Airbus SE responsible for the development and manufacturing of the corporation's defense and space products, while also providing related services. The division was formed in January 2014 during the corporate restructuring of European Aeronautic Defense and Space (EADS), and comprises the former Airbus Military, Astrium and Cassidian divisions. It is the world's second-largest space company after Boeing and one of the top ten defense companies in the world. Airbus Defense and Space has its main office in Taufkirchen, Germany and is led by chief executive officer Michael Schoellhorn. The company consists of three program lines: Military Air Systems (MiAS), Connected Intelligence (CI) and Space Systems. With an operational presence in 35 countries, the division employed 134,000 people from 86 nationalities as of 2023 and contributed to 21% of Airbus revenues as of 2016.

E/D/E Einkaufsbüro Deutscher Eisenhändle.company_description: E/D/E (Einkaufsbüro Deutscher Eisenhändler GmbH) is Europe's largest purchasing and marketing association in the production connection trade with around 1200 medium-sized trading companies in the areas of tools, machinery and industrial equipment, fittings and building components, sanitary and heating, steel and fastening technology, welding, etc. It provides services in central purchasing, logistics, marketing, digital services, and banking services to support its members.

Südzucker AG.company_description: Südzucker AG is a German company and the largest sugar producer in the world, with an annual production of around 4.8 million tonnes. It is involved in the production, processing, and marketing of sugars, primarily sucrose and fructose, and its products are used in a wide range of food and beverage applications.

Agravis Raiffeisen AG.company_description: Agravis Raiffeisen AG is a German agricultural trading and service company. It operates in the agricultural sector, offering a wide range of products and services including agricultural supplies, energy, and machinery. The company is involved in various aspects of agriculture, such as crop production, animal nutrition, and farm management.

Klöckner & Co. SE.company_description: Klöckner & Co. SE is a German producer-independent steel and metal distributor. The company's core business is the sale of steel and non-ferrous metals, and it has an established distribution network with approximately 150 locations.

Edeka Minden-Hannover Stiftung & Co. KG.company_description: Edeka Minden-Hannover Stiftung & Co. KG is a German supermarket corporation and one of the largest supermarket chains in Germany. It operates in the retail industry, offering a wide range of products including groceries, fresh produce, household items, and various other consumer goods.

McKesson Europe AG.company_description: McKesson Europe AG (formerly Celesio AG, previously Gehe AG), with its headquarters in Stuttgart, Germany, is a leading international wholesale and retail company and provider of logistics and services in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors. The company had around 37,000 employees at the end of the 2019 financial year (31 March 2019) and is represented in 13 countries in Europe. In the 2019 financial year the company achieved a turnover of EUR 21.18 billion. The majority shareholder of the company is the US-based McKesson Corporation, which holds a share of 77.01%. The remaining 22.99% of shares are available on the open market. Kevin Kettler, a US citizen, has been Chairman of McKesson Europe since 1 November 2018.

Marquard & Bahls AG.company_description: Marquard & Bahls AG is a Hamburg-based company that is active in the fields of energy and chemicals. Its core lines of business include tank storage logistics, trading, and aviation fuelling. The company has a presence in 33 countries around the world and employs around 6,715 people. In 2019, the company generated revenue of EUR 13.875 billion. Additionally, Oiltanking, a subsidiary of Marquard & Bahls AG, is a logistics service provider of tank terminals for petroleum products, chemicals, and gases, with a total storage capacity of more than 20 million m3. Skytanking, another subsidiary, provides aviation fuelling services including into-plane fuelling, aviation fuel storage and hydrant management, investment in aviation fuel facilities at airports and engineering. It handles 23.2 million cbm of aviation fuel per year, refuels 2 million aircraft, and has operations at 83 airports in 14 countries in Europe, Asia, Africa, and North America.

Eurobaustoff Handelsgesellschaft mbH & C.company_description: Eurobaustoff Handelsgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG operates as a retailer for do-it-yourself home improvement products through its brand I and M Bauzentrum. The company's offerings include a wide range of building supplies and materials for both wholesale and retail distribution.

Vitesco Technologies Group AG.company_description: Vitesco Technologies Group AG is a Germany-based company focusing on the development and production of components and system solutions for the powertrain of hybrid, electric vehicles and combustion engine-based vehicles. The Company's portfolio includes approximately 48 Volt electrification solutions, electric drives, and power electronics. Vitesco spun off from Continental AG in 2021 and ranks No. 31 on the Automotive News list of the top global suppliers, with worldwide sales to automakers of $9.68 billion in 2022.

Noweda Apothekergenossenschaft eG.company_description: Noweda Apothekergenossenschaft eG operates as a central wholesaler for medicines and is a strong partner of local pharmacies. The company provides a comprehensive range of services and support for its member pharmacies, and it has a focus on digital solutions to facilitate the pharmacies' transition into the digital future. Noweda has been a key player in the pharmaceutical wholesale industry for over 80 years and is committed to providing same-day delivery services in collaboration with local pharmacies.

Benteler Business Service GmbH.company_description: Benteler Business Services GmbH operates in the automotive industry and provides metal, automotive engineering, and related services. The company was founded in 2010 and has a total of 33 patents.

Globus Holding GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Globus Holding GmbH & Co. KG, branded as Globus, is a German retail chain of hypermarkets, DIY stores, and electronics stores. Norma is a food discount store with stores in Germany, France, the Czech Republic, and Austria. The United States Bullion Depository, also known as Fort Knox, is a fortified vault building located in Kentucky, operated by the United States Department of the Treasury to store a large portion of the United States' gold reserves and other precious items.

Unternehmensgruppe Theo Müller S.e.c.s..company_description: The Unternehmensgruppe Theo Müller S.e.c.s. operates in the dairy products industry and has acquired brands such as Landliebe, Mondelice, Südmilch, Puddis, Gastro food service, Optiwell, and Fruttis. They are involved in dairy production and have a significant brand presence in Germany.

Beiersdorf AG.company_description: Beiersdorf AG is a German multinational company that manufactures personal-care products and pressure-sensitive adhesives. Its brands include Elastoplast, Eucerin, Labello, La Prairie, Nivea, Tesa SE (Tesa tape), and Coppertone.

Carl Zeiss AG.company_description: Carl Zeiss AG, branded as ZEISS, is a German manufacturer of optical systems and optoelectronics. The company is active in four business segments including Industrial Quality and Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets, and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. It operates in almost 50 countries, has 30 production sites and around 25 development sites worldwide. Carl Zeiss AG is the holding of all subsidiaries within Zeiss Group, of which Carl Zeiss Meditec AG is the only one that is traded at the stock market. The company is owned by the foundation Carl-Zeiss-Stiftung.

Airbus Operations GmbH.company_description: Airbus Operations GmbH, a subsidiary of Airbus, operates in the aircraft manufacturing industry. It is known for its production of the Airbus A320 family of narrow-body airliners, which includes the A318, A319, A320, and A321. The company is also involved in the development and production of the A320neo (new engine option), which offers improved fuel economy. Additionally, Airbus Operations GmbH is associated with the Airbus-owned plant in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, Germany, where corporate, freight, test, and delivery flights, including those of the former Airbus A380, take place.

EWE AG.company_description: EWE AG is an electric utility company based in Germany, and it is the main sponsor of the professional basketball club Baskets Oldenburg. The company is also associated with the Kleine EWE Arena, a dual indoor sporting arena complex located in Oldenburg. Additionally, EWE AG is involved in high-tech start-up investments through its participation in the High-Tech Gründerfonds.

Rhenus SE & Co. KG.company_description: Rhenus SE & Co. KG operates as a leading logistics specialist with business operations around the globe, generating an annual turnover of EUR 8.6 billion. The company has 39,000 employees working at 1,120 business sites and offers innovative solutions along the complete supply chain. Rhenus provides warehouse logistics services, including inbound processes, picking, shipping, and solutions for B2C customers. The company also offers FTZ and Customs Bonded Warehouse services.

Delivery Hero SE.company_description: Delivery Hero SE is a global online food delivery company that focuses on enhancing the quality of its local services through innovation. The company has been facing slowing growth and poor margins despite its high market share and partnerships with leading food brands. It has been working on fostering partnerships and building innovative technological solutions to improve the tech and ecommerce landscape.

B. Braun Melsungen AG.company_description: B. Braun is a German medical and pharmaceutical device company with more than 63,000 employees globally. It has offices and production facilities in over 60 countries and offers more than 5,000 different healthcare products, 95% of which are manufactured by the company. In 2018, the company had a revenue of 6.908 billion Euros.

TK Elevator GmbH.company_description: TK Elevator GmbH operates in the elevator industry, serving customers in over 100 countries with a network of about 1,000 locations. The company offers the EOX Renew, an ultra-flexible elevator that enhances accessibility, sustainability, and property value in older buildings. Additionally, TK Elevator provides products such as escalators, software, and passenger boarding bridges.

Puma SE.company_description: Puma SE is a German multinational corporation that designs and manufactures athletic and casual footwear, apparel, and accessories. It is headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany. Puma is the third largest sportswear manufacturer in the world. The company was founded in 1948 by Rudolf Dassler and is known for its distinctive 'Formstrip' logo. Puma offers a wide range of products including footwear, apparel, and accessories for both athletic and casual use.

Tengelmann Twenty-One KG.company_description: Tengelmann Twenty-One KG is the strategic holding company driving sustainability for the entire corporate group. It is involved in banking, development, and discount retail. The Tengelmann Group, of which it is a part, is a major retail company with diverse investments in Europe and North America.

Telefónica Deutschland Holding AG.company_description: Telefónica Deutschland Holding AG, commonly known as Telefónica Germany, is a German telecommunications provider. It offers both mobile and landline services and is listed on the TecDAX. The company operates in the mobile communications sector and provides a range of products and services, including mobile and broadband internet. As of the end of 2021, Telefónica Deutschland Holding AG had approximately 15.4 million customer contracts, with 11.2 million for mobile services and 4.2 million for broadband internet.

Wacker Chemie AG.company_description: Wacker Chemie AG is a German multinational chemical company with a product range that includes silicone rubbers, polymer products, chemical materials, polysilicon, and wafers for the semiconductor industry. The company operates more than 25 production sites in Europe, Asia, and the Americas and sells its products in over 100 countries. Its corporate annual sales in 2015 were about 5.3 billion Euros, and it had approximately 16,972 employees at that time.

Enercity AG.company_description: Enercity AG is a Hanover-based energy supplier that provides utility services, including the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity, as well as the supply of natural gas, water, and solar energy. The company is actively involved in shaping the energy transition and is increasingly focusing on new business areas such as electromobility, energy efficiency, and smart infrastructure. Enercity supplies about one million customers with electricity, heating, natural gas, and drinking water, and provides services related to e-mobility, decentralized solutions, and energy efficiency.

Dachser SE.company_description: Dachser Group SE & Co. KG is a German freight company involved in European Logistics, Air & Sea Logistics, and Food Logistics business segments. They provide transport, warehousing, and value-added services in the contract logistics sector.

Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH.company_description: Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH is a biotech company that provides in-vitro diagnostics and supplies solutions across various disease areas. It operates through two segments: Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics.

Lanxess AG.company_description: Lanxess AG is a German specialty chemicals company based in Cologne, Germany. It was founded in 2004 as a spin-off of the chemicals division and parts of the polymers business from Bayer AG. The company operates in the specialty chemicals sector and offers a range of products, including Icaridin, an insect repellent, among others.

Helm AG.company_description: Helm AG is a European multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Budapest. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Central and Eastern Europe, with an expanding direct presence in Western Europe, China, Northern America, and Latin America. DB Cargo AG.company_description: DB Cargo (previously known as Railion and DB Schenker Rail) is an international transport and logistics company. The company was founded as DB Cargo AG on 1 January 1999 under the second stage of liberalisation reform of the German railway system (Bahnreform) underway around this time. Initial operations were primarily focused on the rail freight market within Germany; however, during early 2000, the company was reorganised under the Railion holding company as part of a merger between DB Cargo and the Dutch state-owned rail company Nederlanse Spoorwegen's rail freight operations. This new structure was designed for the cooperation, and incorporation, of future partnerships with other rail freight companies; between 2004 and 2009, Railion expanded its operations into Italy, Switzerland, and Poland, typically via acquisitions. Following the acquisition of Schenker AG in the early 2000s, the company was restructured again and adopted the DB Schenker Rail branding. During 2016, to indicate its core focus on rail freight transportation, the company was once more rebranded as DB Cargo AG; this naming scheme has been progressively replicated across the majority of its international subsidiaries as well. The services provided by DB Cargo include both block train and single wagonload transport services, the latter of which have been abandoned by many of the company's rivals. Based on the number of kilometres travelled, DB Cargo is the market leader in both Germany and Europe, although its transport services have been in decline for several years. Seeking to reverse this decline, a more flexible price structure was adopted alongside various cost-cutting measures in 2016. During the early 2020s, major global events such as the COVID-19 pandemic and the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine have challenged the company and driven changes. Within the context of the battle against climate change, however, the role of DB Cargo is also thought to be increasingly important, as the company offers transport options that are entirely carbon neutral. However, the company has been criticised for a lack of investment into both its rolling stock and infrastructure, and thus constraining its performance. In late 2019, Sigrid Evelyn Nikutta took on the role of CEO of DB Cargo.

JET Tankstellen Deutschland GmbH.company_description: JET Tankstellen Deutschland GmbH operates in the petroleum and gas extraction industry and offers a range of services including branded fuel at competitive prices, coffee, snacks, biodegradable car wash, and oil from JET and LIQUI MOLY. Voith GmbH & Co. KGaA.company_description: The Voith Group is a German multinational technology company with a broad portfolio of systems, products, services and digital applications. Edeka Handelsgesellschaft Rhein-Ruhr mbH.company_description: EDEKA Handelsgesellschaft Rhein-Ruhr mbH operates as a part of EDEKA Rhein-Ruhr and is known for its beverage markets with a wide range of offerings, good value for money, and comprehensive service. Jungheinrich AG.company_description: Jungheinrich AG is a German company active in the material handling equipment, warehousing and material flow engineering sectors. In these segments, the company is ranked in second place in Europe, and third in the world.

MVV Energie AG.company_description: MVV Energie AG is a publicly listed company based in Mannheim and is one of Germany's leading energy suppliers, operating in both Germany and Europe. Oldendorff Carriers GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Oldendorff Carriers GmbH & Co. KG is the largest German bulk carrier company. It operates around 700 ships, some chartered, with a carrying capacity of approximately 57 million tonnes.

Deutsche Börse AG.company_description: Deutsche Börse AG or the Deutsche Börse Group, is a German multinational that offers a marketplace for organizing the trading of shares and other securities. SEW-Eurodrive GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: SEW-EURODRIVE GmbH & Co KG is a German manufacturing company located in Bruchsal, Germany. The company produces gear units, motors, electric motor and inverter technology.

Mann+Hummel GmbH.company_description: MANN+HUMMEL Gruppe is a family-owned manufacturer of liquid and air filter systems, intake systems and cabin air filters headquartered in Ludwigsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

MTU Aero Engines AG.company_description: MTU Aero Engines AG is a German aircraft engine manufacturer. MTU develops, manufactures and provides service support for military and civil aircraft engines.  MTU Aero Engines was formerly known as MTU München.

EvoBus GmbH.company_description: Daimler Buses GmbH, formerly EvoBus GmbH, is a German bus and coach manufacturer headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany and a wholly owned subsidiary of Daimler Truck AG. Its products go to market under the brands Mercedes-Benz and Setra.

Messer SE & Co. KGaA.company_description: Messer SE & Co. KGaA operates in Asia, Central and South-Eastern Europe, and Germany. Philips GmbH Market DACH.company_description: Philips GmbH Market DACH operates in the DACH region, which refers to the three Central European countries of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. FTI Touristik GmbH.company_description: FTI Touristik GmbH, part of the FTI GROUP, offers holidays in over 120 countries. Goldbeck GmbH.company_description: The Goldbeck GmbH is a family-run construction company based in Bielefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia. Vinci Deutschland GmbH.company_description: VINCI is a global player in the fields of concessions, energy technology and construction with a presence in approximately 120 countries. The company operates in various sectors including concessions, highways, and energy services.

Hellmann Worldwide Logistics SE & Co. KG.company_name: Hellmann Worldwide Logistics SE & Co. KG

Müller Holding GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Müller Ltd. & Co. KG (Müller) is a chain of retail stores with headquarters in Ulm, Germany. Between 2004 and 2019 the company was registered in London. Since 2019 it has been registered in Vaduz, Liechtenstein.

Enercon GmbH.company_description: Enercon GmbH is a wind turbine manufacturer based in Aurich, Lower Saxony, Germany. It has been the market leader in Germany since the mid-1990s. Bosch Thermotechnik GmbH.company_description: Bosch Thermotechnik GmbH is a company that operates in the field of micro combined heat and power (micro-CHP) technology, which is an extension of the idea of cogeneration to the single/multi-family home or small office building. Rehau AG + Co..company_description: The REHAU Group is a family-owned polymer business, which develops, manufactures and markets products for the automotive, construction, furniture, materials, medical and industrial sectors. Umicore AG & Co. KG.company_description: Umicore AG & Co. KG operates in the areas of chemicals, distribution, information technology, logistics, production, research/laboratory, and services. Webasto SE.company_description: Webasto SE is a company headquartered in Stockdorf, Germany, which makes sunroofs, electric-car chargers and air-conditioning systems. Holger Engelmann is the CEO of the company.

Wilh. Werhahn KG.company_description: Wilh. Werhahn KG operates in the management and consultancy services industry.
