BASF Coatings GmbH.company_description: BASF Coatings GmbH is a subsidiary of BASF SE, which is a European multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. BASF Coatings GmbH operates in the area of coatings and offers a wide range of products for professional coatings, including facade paints, interior wall paints, lacquers, glazing, crack reinforcement, as well as concrete and floor systems.

1&1 AG.company_description: 1&1 AG is a telecommunications provider that offers a comprehensive portfolio of wireless services and broadband access. It also provides bundled products comprising mobile and fixed-network services, as well as value-added services. The company operates in two business segments: Online and Offline, and offers a portfolio of services and products in the field of mobile voice and data services.

Emil Frey Gruppe Deutschland.company_description: Emil Frey Gruppe Deutschland operates in the automotive industry, with a focus on car dealerships and related services. Arrow Central Europe GmbH.company_description: Arrow Central Europe GmbH operates in the distribution services for electronics and has signed a distribution agreement with Isabellenhütte, specializing in the development and manufacture of products based on the properties of electrical and thermoelectric resistors. The company's European headquarters is in Neu-Isenburg, and it includes Isabellenhütte products in its portfolio.

Orlen Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Orlen Deutschland GmbH operates 600 star and ORLEN petrol stations in Germany. It is a 100% subsidiary of the Polish multi-energy group PKN ORLEN S.A. and part of the international ORLEN Group. The company has acquired 17 automatic petrol stations from the Austrian mineral oil group OMV and will operate these under the new ORLEN express brand in the future. This acquisition is part of the company's strategic expansion in southern Germany.

Symrise AG.company_description: Symrise AG is a German chemicals company that is a major producer of flavours and fragrances with sales of €4.618 billion in 2022. Major competitors include Givaudan, Takasago International Corporation, International Flavors and Fragrances and Döhler. Symrise is a member of the European Flavour Association. In 2021, Symrise was ranked 4th by FoodTalks' Global Top 50 Food Flavours and Fragrances Companies list.

Gebr. Heinemann SE & Co. KG.company_description: Gebr. Heinemann SE & Co. KG operates as a global travel retailer with a presence in 19 locations across 7 countries. It has reported a significant increase in Group turnover, despite ongoing travel restrictions in some parts of the world and the war in Ukraine. Gebr. Heinemann is on track to achieve a 'significant' share of its turnover through sustainable products and by working with responsible suppliers.

Stada Arzneimittel AG.company_description: Stada Arzneimittel AG is a pharmaceutical company based in Bad Vilbel, Germany which specializes on a three-pillar strategy consisting of consumer healthcare products (over-the-counter drugs), generics and specialty pharma. Worldwide, STADA Arzneimittel AG sells its products in approximately 120 countries. In 2022, revenue totaled €3.79 billion.Commonly known products produced by Stada are Stada-brand acetaminophen and lactulose, Grippostad-C cold medicine and Ladival sun protection products. Stada is involved in various charity projects and sponsoring activities which include the support for dolphin aid e.V since 2007 and the support of a Romanian children's village in Timișoara.

Dekra SE.company_description: DEKRA is the world’s largest non-listed expert organization in the TIC sector (Testing, Inspection, Certification) founded in Berlin, Germany in 1925 as Deutscher Kraftfahrzeug-Überwachungs-Verein (German Motor Vehicle Inspection Association). At 28 million per year worldwide, DEKRA inspects more vehicles than any other organization. DEKRA is active in the field in more than 20 countries across the globe, from Sweden to South Africa, from the U.S. to New Zealand. The latest additions were Finland, Mexico and Chile. With approximately 48,646 employees and revenues of more than  €3.8 billion, DEKRA is the largest inspection company in Germany and one of the world’s leading expert organizations. By its own account, it is the European market leader. The group focuses on the inspection of vehicles and technical systems, but also offers other services like testing and certification. DEKRA has had its headquarters in Stuttgart since 1946. Business operations are carried out by DEKRA SE, which is wholly owned by DEKRA e. V. The vision for the company’s 100th birthday in 2025 is that DEKRA will be the global partner for a safe, secure and sustainable world. With a platinum rating from EcoVadis, DEKRA is in the top one percent of sustainable businesses ranked.

British American Tobacco Germany GmbH.company_description: British American Tobacco Germany GmbH operates in the tobacco industry and offers a range of products including cigarettes and other tobacco products.

Sonepar Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Sonepar Deutschland GmbH is a business-to-business (B2B) distribution services group focusing on the markets for electrical materials, safety and other maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) products in Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific.

Synlab AG.company_description: SYNLAB Group is an international medical diagnostics provider headquartered in Munich, Germany. SYNLAB is leading in diagnostic services and specialty testing in Europe.

Mainova AG.company_description: Mainova AG is one of the largest regional energy suppliers in Germany and supplies about one million people in Hessen and neighboring provinces with electricity, gas, heat and water. It is based in Frankfurt am Main.

Bilfinger SE.company_description: Bilfinger SE (previously named Bilfinger Berger AG) is a European multinational company specialized in civil and industrial construction, engineering and services based in Mannheim, Germany.

Basell Polyolefine GmbH.company_description: Basell Polyolefine GmbH is a company that operates in the area of polyolefins, which are a type of polymer produced from simple olefins such as ethylene and propylene. ALSO Deutschland GmbH.company_description: ALSO Deutschland GmbH operates in the information and communications technology (ICT) industry, focusing on information technology (IT), consumer electronics (CE), and telecommunication products. Zeppelin GmbH.company_description: Zeppelin GmbH operates in plant engineering for the handling of bulk materials, serving industries such as plastic, rubber, tire, chemicals, and food. They provide services including basic engineering, in-house production of components, and control.

Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH.company_description: Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH is a German family-owned investment holding company headquartered in Duisburg, Germany. The company operates as an investment holding company and is considered one of the wealthiest families in Germany.

OMV Deutschland GmbH.company_description: OMV Deutschland GmbH, a subsidiary of OMV AG, operates in the oil and gas industry, with a focus on sustainability initiatives, digital transformation, and energy efficiency. Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale.company_name: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale.company_description: The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, often simply shortened to GIZ, is the main German development agency. GIZ was established on 1 January 2011, through the merger of three German international development organizations: the Deutscher Entwicklungsdienst (DED), the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Technische Zusammenarbeit (GTZ), and Internationale Weiterbildung und Entwicklung (InWEnt). It is one of the world's largest development agencies, with a business volume in excess of €3.1 billion in 2019 and 22,199 employees spread over more than 120 countries.

Krones AG.company_description: Krones AG is a German packaging and bottling machine manufacturer. It produces lines for filling beverages in plastic and glass bottles or beverage cans. The company manufactures stretch blow-moulding machines for producing PET bottles, fillers, labellers, bottle washers, pasteurisers, inspectors, packers, and palletisers. This product portfolio is complemented by material flow systems and process technology for producing beverages for breweries, dairies, and soft-drink companies.

Fujitsu Technology Solutions GmbH.company_description: Fujitsu Technology Solutions GmbH operates in the information and communication technology (ICT) industry, offering a full range of technology products, solutions, and services. Additionally, Fujitsu combines connected and autonomous vehicle technology with IT services and infrastructure to deliver end-to-end automotive technology solutions.

Wilhelm Hoyer GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Wilhelm Hoyer GmbH & Co. Dürr AG.company_description: Dürr AG operates in the fields of robot, process, and assembly technology for vehicle production, with a focus on painting and final assembly lines. Lufthansa Technik AG.company_description: Lufthansa Technik AG provides worldwide maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services for aircraft, engines, and components. Trumpf GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: TRUMPF Group is a German industrial machine manufacturing company, one of the world's biggest providers of machine tools, with production facilities in various countries. IBM Deutschland GmbH.company_description: IBM Deutschland GmbH operates in the computer services industry, offering cognitive solutions, transaction processing software development, and IT services such as consulting and management of logistic chains, financial performance, and CRM.

N-Ergie AG.company_description: N-ERGIE is an energy company with headquarters in Nuremberg.

Viessmann Werke GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: The Viessmann Group is a German manufacturer of heating and refrigeration systems headquartered in Allendorf (Eder), Germany. Vorwerk SE & Co. KG.company_description: Vorwerk SE & Co. KG is a German diversified corporate group with a wide range of products and services. Cronimet Holding GmbH.company_description: Cronimet Holding GmbH operates in the stainless steel and alloys recycling industry, with a focus on sourcing and supplying high-quality scrap in Northeastern Europe. Festo SE & Co. KG.company_description: Festo is a German automation company based in Esslingen am Neckar, Germany. Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA.company_description: Drägerwerk AG & Co. Sachsen Energie AG.company_description: Sachsen Energie AG is a registered industry association of nearly 300 companies in the microelectronics and related sectors in Saxony, Germany, with around 40,000 employees. MAN Energy Solutions SE.company_description: MAN Energy Solutions SE is a German multinational company based in Augsburg that produces large-bore gas and diesel engines and also turbomachinery for marine, rail and stationary applications, as locomotive and marine propulsion systems, power plant applications, and turbochargers. Kuka AG.company_description: KUKA AG is a German manufacturer of industrial robots and factory automation systems. It is owned by Chinese appliance manufacturer Midea Group. The company operates globally and provides products and services for task automation in the industrial processing of metallic and non-metallic materials for various industries including automotive, energy, aerospace, rail vehicles, and agricultural machinery.

Vaillant Group.company_description: The Vaillant Group is a company that develops products for heating, cooling, and hot water. The company is family-owned and headquartered in Remscheid, North Rhine-Westphalia.

Douglas GmbH.company_description: Douglas GmbH is a German multinational perfumery and cosmetics chain headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. K+S AG.company_description: K+S AG (formerly Kali und Salz GmbH) is a German chemical company headquartered in Kassel. The company is Europe’s largest supplier of potash for use in fertilizer. Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG.company_description: Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG is a German company owned by Rolls-Royce Holdings with holdings in engine manufacturing brands and facilities. Swiss Steel Group.company_description: Schmolz + Bickenbach AG, renamed as Swiss Steel Holding AG and Swiss Steel Group, is a listed steel group based in Lucerne, Switzerland. The group employs more than 10,000 people and generated revenues of EUR 3.3 billion in 2018.

Fressnapf Holding SE.company_description: Fressnapf Holding SE is Europe's market leader for pet supplies, with a focus on pet food and supplies. Nestlé Deutschland AG.company_description: Nestlé Deutschland AG is the German subsidiary company of the food multinational company Nestlé. It is one of Germany's main food companies. Novelis Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Novelis Deutschland GmbH, a leading producer of flat-rolled aluminum products and the world's largest recycler of aluminum, operates in the fields of aluminum packaging, industrial packaging, glass packaging, plastic packaging, and corrugated board. Gemalto GmbH.company_description: Gemalto GmbH is a global digital security company that provides a wide range of products and services to help organizations and individuals secure their digital identities, data, and transactions. Tchibo GmbH.company_description: Tchibo GmbH is a German chain of coffee retailers and cafés known for its range of non-coffee products that change weekly. The company is headquartered in Hamburg. Tchibo's coffee is sold in supermarkets and other smaller stores in various countries.

Aunde Group.company_description: The Aunde Group operates in the management and consultancy services, research & development, and energy management industries. Its products and services include surface technologies, seat systems, technical springs, interior modules, and technical plastic parts.

Diehl Stiftung & Co. KG.company_description: Diehl Stiftung & Co. KG operates in the defense and industrial sectors. Alfred Kärcher SE & Co. KG.company_description: Alfred Kärcher SE & Co. KG is a German family-owned company that operates worldwide and is known for its high-pressure cleaners, floor care equipment, parts cleaning systems, wash water treatment, military decontamination equipment and window vacuum cleaners. In 2017, it posted sales revenues of €2.5 billion ($2.88 billion) and sold more than 13 million machines. Kärcher has 100 subsidiaries in 60 countries. In 2020, Kärcher established its North American headquarters in Aurora, Colorado.

Hewlett Packard GmbH.company_description: Hewlett Packard GmbH, also known as HP, provides a wide variety of hardware components, software, and related services to consumers, small and medium-sized businesses, and large enterprises, including customers in the government, health, and education sectors. HP is a global leader in the personal systems and printing industries, with a combined total addressable market in excess of $500 billion.

Arlanxeo Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Arlanxeo Deutschland GmbH operates in the production of polybutadiene rubber (PBR), thermoplastic vulcanisates (TPVs), and synthetic rubber solutions for lithium-ion batteries. Saria SE & Co. KG.company_description: Saria SE & Co. KG is a German agriculture group that is involved in converting animal origin and other organic materials into valuable inputs for new purposes. KG completed the acquisition of Devro plc, a leading supplier of collagen-based films and coatings for food, which is used in the production of sausages and other meat products.

August Storck KG.company_description: August Storck KG, doing business as Storck, is a German candy producer with headquarters in Berlin. The company is known for producing Toffifee, Mamba fruit chews, and other confectionery products.

Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. Wirtgen Group.company_description: Wirtgen Group is an internationally operating German company in the construction industry. The company has recently resumed production at its blast furnace and has ordered new copper staves for its steel plants.

Apleona GmbH.company_description: Apleona GmbH is a leading European facility management services provider with a focus on integrated facility management services based on a technical edge. They offer technical facility management services, complemented by infrastructural and commercial facility management as part of an integrated offering. Apleona recently announced a merger agreement with Gegenbauer Group, one of the leading facility management providers in Germany, creating a European industry leader with 40,000 employees and revenue of EUR 3.5 billion.

Expert SE.company_description: Expert SE is a company that has introduced the new area and shopfitting concept called 'expert Family Entertainment', which focuses on creating specialist shops and markets that provide a world of experience for the whole family. Additionally, the company is involved in retail environments, sales engineering, and employs subject matter experts (SMEs) and sales specialists with in-depth knowledge of the organization's products and services.

ZDF.company_description: ZDF (Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen) is a German public-service television broadcaster based in Mainz, Rhineland-Palatinate. It is known for its famous programs such as heute, a newscast established in 1963, and Wetten, dass..?, an entertainment show that premiered in 1981. ZDF is financed by television license fees and advertising revenues.

PreussenElektra GmbH.company_description: PreussenElektra GmbH, a subsidiary of E.ON, is responsible for the operation and decommissioning of E.ON's nuclear assets, including ownership stakes in several nuclear power plants. It was formerly known as E.ON Kernkraft GmbH and operates in the nuclear energy sector.

Senvion SA.company_description: Senvion SA operates in the wind turbine manufacturing industry and offers a range of wind turbine models, including the 3.7M144 EBC and 3.6M118 NES, designed for low and high wind sites, respectively. The company also provides operations and maintenance services for wind turbines, with a dedicated team of over 90 personnel in India.

Röchling SE & Co. KG.company_description: Röchling SE & Co. KG is a plastics engineering company headquartered in Mannheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The company has three divisions: Industrial, Automotive and Medical. Currently Röchling employs 11,245 people in 90 locations across 25 countries (North- and South America, Europe and Asia), with annual sales of €2.207 billion in 2021.

Raiffeisen Waren-Zentrale Rhein-Main eG.company_description: Raiffeisen Waren-Zentrale Rhein-Main eG is one of the oldest and largest agricultural traders in Germany, with activities also in neighboring countries. As a wholesaler, they play an important role in the agricultural value chain by offering a range of products, services, and expertise. The company is the third largest agricultural cooperative in Germany and has recently transitioned to a joint-stock company (AG). In the fiscal year 2022, the RWZ group significantly exceeded its business goals, achieving a primary price-related revenue growth of 37% to reach 3.0 billion euros.

Envia Mitteldeutsche Energie AG.company_description: Envia Mitteldeutsche Energie AG is the leading regional energy service provider in East Germany. The company supplies more than 1.3 million customers with electricity, gas, heat, and energy services. They are also involved in solar and wind energy projects, as well as the operation of solar power plants.

Hauptgenossenschaft Nord AG.company_description: Hauptgenossenschaft Nord AG, also known as team agrar AG, is a company based in Kiel, Germany. It is involved in the sourcing and distribution of food and agricultural products from over 70 countries, offering solutions for production and shipment.

EK Group GmbH (Einkaufsgemeinschaft).company_description: EK Group GmbH (Einkaufsgemeinschaft) operates in the retail and software trading industries. It is involved in the operation of a system gastronomy with multiple branches and an online presence. Additionally, it has been involved in the acquisition of EK-Pack Folien GmbH, a manufacturer of high-quality film and foil technology located in Bavaria, Germany.

KSB AG.company_description: KSB SE & Co. KGaA is a German multinational manufacturer of pumps, valves with headquarters in Frankenthal (Pfalz), Germany. The KSB Group has manufacturing plants, sales and marketing organizations, and service operations on every continent.

C&A Mode GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: C&A Mode GmbH & Co. KG is a German clothing retailer that operates in multiple European countries. It has introduced a membership program called 'C&A for you' in several European countries to enhance the shopping experience. The company sources its products from 36 different global suppliers, with Brazil hosting the highest number of suppliers as of January 2022.

Fraport AG.company_description: Fraport AG, commonly known as Fraport, is a German transport company which operates Frankfurt Airport in Frankfurt am Main and holds interests in the operation of several other airports around the world. The company is also involved in ground handling operations at its own operated airports and at third-party operated airports.

Bayerngas GmbH.company_description: Bayerngas GmbH, also known as Bayerngas, was an oil and gas company with operations in several North-European countries. The company operated upstream with licenses in Norwegian, Danish, and British sectors. Established in 2006, Bayerngas was owned by German, Austrian, and Swiss local authorities. In December 2017, Bayerngas Norge was combined with the exploration & production business of Centrica plc to create a new independent oil and gas operator, Spirit Energy.

Paul Hartmann AG.company_description: Paul Hartmann AG is a Germany-based holding company principally engaged in the field of medical and healthcare products. It operates through four segments: Wound Management, Incontinence Management, Infection Management, and Other Group Activities. The company manufactures and sells medical and care products in Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania, including disinfectant products, incontinence management products, and personal healthcare products.

Computacenter AG & Co. OHG.company_description: Computacenter plc is a British multinational that provides computer services to public- and private-sector customers. It is a UK company based in Hatfield, Hertfordshire. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung de.company_name: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e.V.
Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung de.company_description: The Fraunhofer Society is a German research organization with 76 institutes spread throughout Germany, each focusing on different fields of applied science. It has some 30,800 employees, mainly scientists and engineers, and an annual research budget of about €3.0 billion. The organization is the biggest in Europe for applied research and development services. One of its notable institutes is the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems, which performs applied scientific and engineering research and development for all areas of solar energy.

Georgsmarienhütte GmbH.company_description: Georgsmarienhütte GmbH, a subsidiary of GMH Gruppe, is investing in new technologies to increase occupational safety and reduce CO2 emissions. It is a pioneer in the use of electric arc furnaces and focuses on sustainable steel production and recycling.

Toom Baumarkt GmbH.company_description: Toom Baumarkt GmbH is one of Germany's leading DIY brands, with more than 300 stores and gross sales of over 3.1 billion euros in 2022. It offers products and services for price-conscious craftsmen, DIY enthusiasts, and bargain hunters, including discount building and garden markets.

Giesecke & Devrient GmbH.company_description: Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) is a German company headquartered in Munich that provides banknote and securities printing, smart cards, and cash handling systems.

Lufthansa Cargo AG.company_description: Lufthansa Cargo AG is a German cargo airline and a wholly owned subsidiary of Lufthansa. It operates worldwide air freight and logistics services and is headquartered at Frankfurt Airport, the main hub of Lufthansa. Besides operating dedicated cargo planes, the company also has access to cargo capacities of 350 passenger aircraft of the Lufthansa Group.

J. Bünting Beteiligungs AG.company_description: J. Bünting Beteiligungs AG operates in the management and consulting industry, with a focus on retail, logistics, and meat products. Its subsidiaries include famila, Combi, and Bünting Category Management, among others. The company is involved in the tea market in Germany and is known for reviving the charm of colonial stores through J. Bünting Coloniale.

Zedach eG.company_description: Zedach eG operates in the construction industry and offers a cloud-based construction site maintenance app called Baustellen, which provides extensive product information, data sheets, inventory management, and other features for the roofing sector.

Sky Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Sky Deutschland GmbH, branded as Sky, is a German media company that operates a direct broadcast satellite Pay TV platform in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. It provides a collection of basic and premium digital subscription television channels of different categories via satellite and cable television. It was launched in 1991 as Premiere and has since consisted of many channels with many new ones added over the years. Sky Deutschland is a wholly owned subsidiary of Comcast-owned Sky.

Hüttenwerke Krupp Mannesmann GmbH.company_description: Hüttenwerke Krupp Mannesmann GmbH, also known as HKM, is a German steel company based in Duisburg. It is owned by ThyssenKrupp and operates in the heavy industry sector, specifically in steel production. The company is known for its production of steel products and operates the Rhine ports of Schwelgern and Walsum-Süd. HKM has a significant presence in the transportation and communication sector, particularly in railways and shipping.

Rolls-Royce Deutschland Ltd & Co KG.company_description: Rolls-Royce Deutschland Ltd & Co KG is involved in the production of turbofan engines, specifically the BR700-710A1-10, BR700-710A2-20, and BR700-710C4-11 models. The company has been the subject of a new airworthiness directive (AD) issued by the FAA due to reports of cracks on certain low-pressure compressor (LPC) rotor (fan) disks.

Wortmann Schuh-Holding KG.company_description: Wortmann Schuh-Holding KG operates in the shoe industry and offers products under various brands, including Caprice. The company focuses on using sustainable materials for shoe production and has received recognition for its innovative work.

DER Touristik GmbH.company_description: DER Touristik GmbH is a German tourism company that operates in the travel and tourism industry. It offers a wide range of travel services, including package holidays, hotel accommodations, and flights to leisure destinations. The company is known for its focus on providing diverse travel experiences and destinations for its customers.

Leonhard Weiss GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Leonhard Weiss GmbH & Co. KG is a well-established construction company. The company's operations span a wide range of construction-related activities, including network construction, civil engineering, rail infrastructure, structural engineering, turnkey construction, and building rehabilitation. Their services encompass both new construction projects and the maintenance or rehabilitation of existing structures. The company's broad portfolio reflects its versatility and comprehensive capabilities within the construction industry.

Radeberger Gruppe KG.company_description: Radeberger Gruppe KG is a German company headquartered in Frankfurt, known for the production of Radeberger beer. It employs over 2,000 people in the country and is involved in the beverage industry.

Schott AG.company_description: Schott AG is an international technology group and inventor of specialty glass. It has achieved strong growth in the United States, with U.S. sales of over $520 million in fiscal year 2021-22. The company's SCHOTT MINIFAB division offers solutions for contract design and manufacturing of rapid diagnostics devices. Additionally, Schott AG plans to raise at least €813 million from the initial public offering of its specialty medical-glassware unit.

Krüger GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Krüger GmbH & Co KG operates in the civil engineering and building construction industries, offering services in civil engineering, maintenance, and wastewater technology. Additionally, the company is involved in the pharmaceuticals industry and employs 2,001-5,000 people with a revenue of $1B-$5B.

Nordzucker AG.company_description: Nordzucker AG is one of the world's leading producers of sugar from beet and cane. They provide deep insights into their sugar production and offer various sugar products. In the 2022/23 season, Nordzucker produced about 2.5 million metric tons of refined sugar.

Kautex Textron GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Kautex Textron GmbH & Co. KG is expanding its portfolio to offer smart products and data-driven services to its customers, including thermoplastic composite and composite-metal hybrid battery systems. It has received the first order from an automotive OEM for a thermoplastic composite underbody battery protection skid plate, and it also offers a lightweight, customizable solution produced from thermoplastic or composite metal hybrid for on-and-off-road applications.

Saint-Gobain Building Distribution Deuts.company_description: Saint-Gobain Building Distribution Deutschland GmbH is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, a global building products company. The acquisition of Saint-Gobain Building Distribution Ltd by Stark Group A/S enhances Saint-Gobain's presence in light and sustainable construction. The subsidiary operates in Canada and offers roofing and siding products.

Volvo Car Germany GmbH.company_description: Volvo Car Germany GmbH operates in the automotive industry, offering a range of cars and related services. The company is part of the Volvo Group, which provides transport and infrastructure solutions, including trucks, buses, construction equipment, and power solutions for marine and industrial applications.

Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG operates in the electronic test equipment, military radiocommunication & air traffic control solutions, cybersecurity services, and broadcast & media solutions. The company designs innovative signal intelligence systems and offers tailored services to ensure air safety and security.

TÜV Rheinland AG.company_description: TÜV Rheinland is an internationally active, independent service company from Germany that tests, inspects, and certifies technical systems, facilities, and objects of all kinds in order to minimize hazards and prevent damages. It is part of the TÜV Rheinland Group, which is one of the three large holding companies along with TÜV Nord and TÜV SÜD, and also includes smaller independent companies such as TÜV Thüringen, TÜV Saarland, and TÜV Austria.

Süwag Vertrieb AG & Co. KG.company_description: Süwag Vertrieb AG & Co. KG operates in the energy sector, focusing on the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity, gas, heat, and water. The company is involved in the operation of wind farms and the provision of energy-related services.

DB Netz AG.company_description: DB Netz AG is a major subsidiary of Deutsche Bahn that owns and operates a majority of the German railway system. It is one of the largest railway infrastructure managers by length and transport volume of its network. The company is profitable from route fees but receives extensive public funding for maintaining, developing, and extending the network of European and federal transportation routes. It is also overseen by the Federal Network Agency and is set to merge with DB Station&Service to form DB InfraGO in 2024.

Roche Pharma AG.company_description: F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, commonly known as Roche, is a Swiss multinational healthcare company that operates worldwide under two divisions: Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics. Its holding company, Roche Holding AG, has shares listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. The company headquarters are located in Basel. Roche is the fifth-largest pharmaceutical company in the world by revenue and the leading provider of cancer treatments globally. The company controls the American biotechnology company Genentech, which is a wholly owned affiliate, and the Japanese biotechnology company Chugai Pharmaceuticals, as well as the United States-based companies Ventana and Foundation Medicine. Roche's revenues during fiscal year 2020 were 58.32 billion Swiss francs. Descendants of the founding Hoffmann and Oeri families own slightly over half of the bearer shares with voting rights, with Swiss pharma firm Novartis owning a further third of its shares until 2021. Roche is one of the few companies increasing their dividend every year, for 2020 as the 34th consecutive year. F. Hoffmann-La Roche is a full member of the European Federation of Pharmaceutical Industries and Associations (EFPIA).

JM Holding GmbH & Co. KGaA.company_description: JM Holding GmbH & Co. KGaA operates in the plastic and wholesale trade industries, offering products and services such as plastic software and films. The company had a balance sheet total of 200 million euros in 2021.

RAG Deutsche Steinkohle AG.company_description: RAG Deutsche Steinkohle AG, also known as RAG, was a German company that operated in the coal mining industry. The company played a significant role in the coal mining industry in Saarland, which ended in June 2012. Additionally, Wilhelm Werner Müller, a German businessman and politician, served as CEO of RAG AG from 2003, overseeing the reduction of Germany's dependence on coal in a socially responsible manner.

Europa Möbel-Verbund GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Europa Möbel-Verbund GmbH & Co. KG operates in the wholesale and advertising, marketing, and PR industries. The company offers furniture, kitchens, and environmental projects. In the fiscal year 2022, the company achieved a centralized turnover of €1.81 billion, representing a 9.08% increase from the previous year.

Getrag GmbH & Cie. KG.company_description: Getrag GmbH & Cie. KG is a medium-sized automotive company based in North Carolina with 500 employees and a revenue of $39.0M. The company is involved in the automotive industry and offers products such as longitudinal orientation, transverse orientation, and transaxles.

Fiege Logistik Stiftung & Co. KG.company_description: Fiege Logistik Stiftung & Co. KG operates as an innovative logistics provider in Europe, offering cross-sector, modular solutions in logistics, real estate, ventures, and digital services. The company has taken over World Fashion Logistics (WFL) to expand its contract logistics operations in Asia and has a long-standing partnership with Continental in tire logistics.

Mars Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Mars Deutschland GmbH operates in the confectionery, food, and pet care industries. The company is known for its iconic brands such as M&M'S® candy, BEN'S ORIGINAL™ rice, and PEDIGREE® pet food. Mars, Incorporated is also investing over $1 billion in driving climate action and has released The Mars Net Zero Roadmap, a plan for achieving Net Zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050.

Alba Group plc & Co.KG.company_description: ALBA Group plc & Co.KG operates as one of the leading recycling and environmental services companies, providing raw materials worldwide. Its product and service portfolio includes waste management consultation, packaging licensing, recycling solutions, sorting technologies, logistics, product development, and raw material delivery.

Zooplus AG.company_description: Zooplus AG is an online retailer of pet food and supplies with headquarters in Munich, Germany. It was founded in 1999 and ships to 30 countries in Europe and the United Kingdom. After its IPO in 2008, Zooplus is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the SDAX stock market index. The company has experienced significant sales growth and has been the subject of a bidding war between private equity firms.

Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG.company_description: The Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG is a municipal utility company operating in the fields of electricity, natural gas, drinking water, and district heating supply, waste disposal, and mobility. It is majority-owned by the energy corporation EnBW.

Finanz Informatik GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Finanz Informatik GmbH & Co. KG operates as an IT service provider and outsourcing partner for savings banks and state banks, serving as an integral partner of the S-Finanzgruppe and other organizations in the finance sector. The company offers IT services, project-based IT consulting, individual software development, and application management.

Kaefer SE & Co. KG.company_description: Kaefer SE & Co. KG , headquartered in Bremen, is a provider of technical industrial services. Products and services Kaefer SE & Co. KG provides are Insulation Solutions: f.exp peat insulation for refrigeration rooms, Access Technology: Development of solutions for accessing various structures, Surface Protection: Providing protective measures for surfaces, Passive Fire Protection: Measures to prevent the spread of fires without active intervention, Refractory Construction: Construction involving fire-resistant materials, Interior Construction: Services for the interior construction of industrial, marine & offshore, and construction sites.

Celanese GmbH.company_description: Celanese GmbH is a global technology and specialty materials company that operates in the production of engineered materials, acetyl chain, cellulose acetate, and food ingredients. The company has over 7,700 employees across the globe and operates in 40 countries, manufacturing products in 11 facilities.

Bernard Krone Holding GmbH & Co. KG.company_name: Bernard Krone Holding GmbH & Co. KG
Bernard Krone Holding GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Bernard Krone Holding SE & Co. KG is an agricultural technology and commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Spelle in the Emsland district, Lower Saxony. The company acts as the parent company and corporate headquarters of the Krone Group. The Krone Group is wholly owned by the Krone family.

Schmitz Cargobull AG.company_description: Schmitz Cargobull AG is a German manufacturer of semi-trailers, trailers, and truck bodies. The company is headquartered in Horstmar, Germany, and is the market leader in Europe. It had 6,500 employees in the 2018/2019 business year and generated a turnover of 2.290 billion euros. The families of Dr. Heinz Schmitz, Peter Schmitz, and Bernd Hoffmann hold equal shares in the company.

AG der Dillinger Hüttenwerke.company_description: Dillinger Hütte is a steel producer in Dillingen, in the German Federal State of Saarland, and has a history stretching back more than three hundred years. The plant was founded in 1685, and was Germany's first Aktiengesellschaft, or joint stock company (1809). The first continuous-caster for slabs in the world was commissioned in Dillingen in 1962. A further machine, permitting casting of slabs of up to 400 mm in thickness - the thickest produced anywhere in the world at that time - was added, along with other new facilities, in 1998. In 2010, Dillinger Hütte successfully produced the first 450 mm thick slab - another world record. The principal equipment in the rolling mill now takes the form of two four-high stands, of which one is currently the largest in the world, with an effective rolling width of 5.5 m and a rolling pressure of 110 MN.

Einrichtungspartnerring VME GmbH & Co. K.company_description: Einrichtungspartnerring VME GmbH & Co. KG operates as a furniture purchasing association and has presented various highlights for the upcoming furnishing year. The company achieved a regulated turnover of 1.76 billion euros, marking a 10.3% increase compared to the previous year.

Heag Holding AG - Beteiligungsmanagement.company_name: Heag Holding AG - Beteiligungsmanagement der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt
Heag Holding AG - Beteiligungsmanagement.company_description: HEAG Holding AG - Beteiligungsmanagement der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt is involved in various activities such as fair cup products, corporate governance, and financial contributions to the Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt. The company's press releases and activities indicate its engagement in corporate governance and financial matters.

Bauer AG.company_description: Bauer AG is a Germany-based holding company of a global group of more than 110 companies operating in the fields of construction and machinery manufacturing. It is divided into three business segments. The Construction segment carries out the established methods and techniques of specialist foundation engineering. The company has been recognized for its commitment to the health and safety of its employees and has experienced growth in total group revenues and order backlog.

Olympus Europa SE & Co. KG.company_description: Olympus Europa SE & Co. KG operates in the medical technology industry, focusing on designing and delivering innovative solutions for medical and surgical procedures. The company offers products such as EndoClot SIS, EndoClot Adhesive, EndoClot Polysaccharide Hemostatic Spray, and EndoClot Submucosal Injection. Additionally, they have launched the Olympus ETD, a model in the company's Infection Prevention portfolio, designed to make endoscope reprocessing more efficient and sustainable.

Gauselmann AG.company_description: Gauselmann AG is a family-owned business group in the entertainment and leisure industry, known for developing, producing, and distributing entertainment gaming devices with and without the possibility of winning money, as well as money management systems. The company also operates a chain of gaming arcades and is involved in sports betting, online gaming, financial services, and casinos.

Bäko-Zentrale eG.company_description: Bäko-Zentrale eG operates in the artisan bakery sector and offers a range of products including dried fruit products such as sea buckthorn, acerola, and blueberry, as well as machinery and equipment for bakeries. The company also participates in industry events and provides cooperative solutions for the baking industry.

Xella International GmbH.company_description: Xella International GmbH is a leading European materials provider of sustainable, efficient, and affordable walling solutions. The company's revenue increased to €1.37 billion in 2022, marking a growth of 17 per cent compared to the previous year. Xella's product range increasingly meets the demand for efficient and sustainable building solutions. The company's ESG strategy is based on reducing CO2 emissions, developing material circularity, and ensuring a safe, diverse, and inclusive workplace.

Schüco International KG.company_description: Schuco is a German manufacturing company founded in 1912 by Heinrich Müller and the businessman Heinrich Schreyer in Nuremberg, popularly known as Germany's toy capital. The company's specialty was making toy reproductions of cars and trucks in tin, plastic and die-cast. The company went bankrupt in 1976 but was reorganized in 1993 and then totally independent again by 1996. Some of the products currently commercialised by Schuco include die-cast scale model cars, aircraft, ships, and commercial vehicles.

Pfizer Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Pfizer Deutschland GmbH is a leading pharmaceutical company with competitive operations in the global market. The company's multinational operations enable it to benefit from economic upswings in various regional markets, despite crises in others. It was founded in 1849 and has 36 manufacturing sites worldwide, sells products in over 185 countries, and has 83 projects in its pipeline. The company has approximately 83,000 employees globally and 7 products with sales greater than $1 billion in 2023. The CEO is Albert Bourla, and the global headquarters is located in 66 Hudson Yards, New York, NY, USA.

Grammer AG.company_description: Grammer AG operates in the automotive and commercial vehicles sectors, with a focus on electrified mobility and digitization. The company aims for profitable growth and has expressed optimism for the financial year 2023.

SKF GmbH.company_description: SKF GmbH operates in the development, design, and manufacturing of bearings, seals, and lubrication systems. It has two segments: Industrial and Automotive. The Industrial segment focuses on rotating shaft services, machine health assessment, reliability engineering, and remanufacturing.

LEAG.company_description: LEAG is the joint brand of Lausitz Energie Verwaltungs GmbH, Lausitz Energie Bergbau AG, and Lausitz Energie Kraftwerke AG. The companies within LEAG operate in the business fields of mining, power plants, and distribution. The lignite coal extracted in mining is used to supply the large power plants operated by LEAG in the power plant sector. Additionally, it undergoes refinement at the Schwarze Pumpe location in the briquette factory, which is part of the distribution segment. In the power plant and distribution business, the generated electricity is sold on the forward and spot markets.

Reemtsma Cigarettenfabriken GmbH.company_description: Reemtsma Cigarettenfabriken GmbH is one of the biggest tobacco and cigarette manufacturing companies in Europe and a subsidiary of Imperial Brands. The company's headquarters is in Hamburg, Germany. The company's products include the Juno brand of cigarettes.

Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG.company_name: Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG
Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG.company_description: Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG is a leading talent company that provides human resource services, including temporary staffing, permanent placement, outsourcing, and career transition. It operates through two business lines: Staffing and Solutions. The company's purpose is to enable sustainable and lifelong employability for individuals and deliver digital and engineering solutions to power the Smart Industry transformation.

DPD Deutschland GmbH.company_description: DPD Deutschland GmbH operates as a parcel shipping company, providing domestic and international parcel shipping services, including logistics optimization and planning. The company offers various delivery options such as DPD CLASSIC, DPD 8:30, DPD 10:00, DPD 12:00, DPD 18:00, DPD PARCELLetter, and DPD Guarantee. Additionally, DPD Deutschland is part of DPDgroup and has entered into a partnership with Open Pricer for pricing software, as part of its digitization roadmap.

Westdeutsche Lotterie GmbH & Co. oHG.company_description: Westdeutsche Lotterie GmbH & Co. oHG is a German state-owned lottery company that operates various lottery games and products.

Intersport.company_description: Intersport operates as a global sporting goods retailer, with a focus on sports and outdoor products. The company has introduced a new strategy called 'GROW TOGETHER FASTER' and has strengthened its position in most of the markets in which it operates. Intersport offers a range of sports and outdoor products and provides property creation, content production, and robust marketing services.

GVS Gasversorgung Süddeutschland GmbH.company_description: Gasversorgung Süddeutschland GmbH operates within the EnBW Group and is involved in gas supply. The company's sales activities are based on classic key account sales in the industry and municipal utility segments.

Friedrich Boysen GmbH & Co. KG.company_description: Friedrich Boysen GmbH & Co. KG operates in the development and manufacture of high-performance exhaust systems. The company has 5200 employees worldwide and its turnover has risen to 3.31 billion Euro. Since 2023, the Boysen Group operates at 27 locations worldwide.

Hyundai Motor Deutschland GmbH.company_description: Hyundai Motor Deutschland GmbH operates in the automotive industry and offers a range of vehicles, including the Hyundai i20, KONA Elektro, STARIA, and other models. The company also focuses on sustainability and innovation, as evidenced by its circular economy platform and hydrogen city bus collaboration with Iveco Group.

Imperial Logistic International B.V. & C.company_name: Imperial Logistic International B.V. & Co. KG
Imperial Logistic International B.V. & C.company_description: Imperial Logistics International B.V. & Co. KG operates as a professional and reliable partner for worldwide flows of goods, offering logistics, vehicle, and financial services in Southern Africa, Europe, and the United Kingdom.

Philip Morris GmbH.company_description: Philip Morris GmbH, a subsidiary of Philip Morris International, operates in the tobacco industry and is focused on delivering a smoke-free future. The company's products include a range of tobacco and smoke-free products, and it is committed to adhering to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) requirements.

Entega AG.company_description: Entega AG is a medium-sized diversified utility with a considerable share of regulated and contracted earnings. It is involved in solar and wind energy projects, including the realization of solar projects with industrial groups. The company's activities align with sustainable development goals related to hunger, health, education, and gender equality.

Westfalen AG.company_description: Westfalen AG is involved in the development of green hydrogen refueling stations, battery storage facilities, and e-fuels. The company is also piloting an unmanned store concept called 'Alvore Smart Shop' in Münster, Germany.

KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft.company_description: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft is a professional service company and one of the Big Four auditors, along with Deloitte, EY, and PwC. It provides audit, tax, and advisory services, including management consulting, corporate finance, and legal services.

Vivantes - Netzwerk für Gesundheit GmbH.company_description: Vivantes - Netzwerk für Gesundheit GmbH operates as a healthcare network in Berlin, offering medical services, including neurology, nuclear medicine, and cancer diagnostics. The company also provides ongoing medical and nursing education and training, as well as information on hygiene and coronavirus prevention.

Thüringer Energie AG.company_description: Thüringer Energie AG is a German energy company operating in the state of Thuringia. It is involved in electricity distribution and offers various energy products and services to its customers.

Tesa SE.company_description: Tesa SE is a German company manufacturing adhesive products. Founded in 2001, the company was previously a division of Beiersdorf, remaining a subsidiary thereof after becoming an independent company. In Germany, the brand name has become synonymous with adhesive tape, and is listed in the Duden dictionary as such. In addition to its consumer adhesive tapes, the company also supplies adhesives to other industries. Clients include Apple and Samsung, for whom Tesa supplies adhesives to build smartphones and tablet computers, as well as the car industry, where the company provides adhesives for a wide range of applications like windows, sensors and displays.

Gruner + Jahr GmbH.company_description: Gruner + Jahr GmbH is a publishing house headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. Gruner + Jahr was acquired by RTL Deutschland in 2021 and later renamed to RTL Publishing.

RWE Deutschland AG.company_description: RWE AG is a German multinational energy company headquartered in Essen. It generates and trades electricity in the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and the United States. The company is the world's second-largest offshore wind power generation and Europe's third-largest company in renewable energy. In the 2020 Forbes Global 2000, the RWE Group was ranked as the 297th-largest public company in the world. RWE confirmed in December 2015 that it would separate its renewable energy generation, power grid and retail operations into a separate company, Innogy SE, during 2016, and sell a 10% holding in the business through an initial public offering. The restructuring was prompted by efforts to reduce the group's exposure to nuclear decommissioning costs, required due to a German government policy of closing all nuclear power stations by 2022. In July 2019, RWE's handling of the conflict with activists in the Hambach Forest were strongly criticized in the media. The company finally agreed to refrain from clearing the forest until autumn 2020. In July 2020, RWE completed a far-reaching asset swap deal with E.ON first announced in 2018, whereby the international renewable generation portfolio of E.ON and Innogy were transferred to RWE.

Takko Holding GmbH.company_description: Takko Holding GmbH operates as a leading European fashion discounter, with a focus on sustainable and responsible production conditions, as well as improving cotton farming globally. Its product range includes seed varieties for sugar beet, corn, cereals, oil and protein plants, sorghum, catch crops, and vegetables. The company's original headquarters were in Klein Wanzleben, an East German town located near the city of Magdeburg. Condor Flugdienst GmbH.company_description: Condor Flugdienst GmbH is a German leisure airline established in 1955 with Frankfurt Airport being its main base. Condor offers scheduled flights to leisure destinations and operates, from Germany, medium-haul flights to the Mediterranean Basin and the Canary Islands as well as long-haul flights to destinations in Africa, Asia, North America, South America and the Caribbean. Whereas medium-haul flights are operated from many German airports (and Zurich), long-haul flights usually depart from Frankfurt, with a few rotations operated from Düsseldorf and Munich. Condor also operates charter flights.

Staatliche Toto-Lotto GmbH.company_description: Staatliche Toto-Lotto GmbH operates as a state-owned lottery company in Germany, conducting state-authorized lotteries nationwide according to common principles. BASF Schwarzheide GmbH.company_description: BASF Schwarzheide GmbH is a subsidiary of BASF SE, a European multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. It operates as a chemical production site in Schwarzheide, Germany, and supplies products to a wide variety of industries.

VTG AG.company_description: VTG AG is a leading asset and logistics company in Europe's rail freight space, offering sustainable and safe transportation of alternative energy sources by rail. The company is involved in combined transport solutions, such as r2L, which enables the use of semitrailers for combined transports, and is committed to shifting freight consignments from road to rail. Additionally, VTG is investing in carbon-neutral maintenance workshops for its freight wagon fleet and has undergone staff changes and legal form changes to continue its business activities.

Siltronic AG.company_description: Siltronic AG is a manufacturer of wafers made of hyperpure silicon, the basis for modern micro- and nanotechnology. The Munich-based company is one of the world's leading manufacturers of wafers for the semiconductor industry.

Vossloh AG.company_description: Vossloh AG is a rail technology company based in Werdohl, Germany. It is a global market leader for rail fasteners and switch systems, and in North America, it is the leading manufacturer of concrete railway ties. The company's customers include public and private railway companies, network operators, as well as regional and municipal transport companies. Since its restructuring, Vossloh has been focusing on target markets in China, the US, Russia, and Western Europe. The company has production sites in Germany, France, Luxembourg, Poland, and Scandinavia, as well as subsidiaries in Asia, North and South America, Australia, and Russia.

Meggle AG.company_description: Meggle is a milk and whey processing company based in Wasserburg am Inn, Germany.

VDM Metals GmbH.company_description: VDM Metals Group (formerly Vereinigte Deutsche Metallwerke) based in Werdohl, Germany, is a manufacturer of corrosion-resistant, heat-resistant and high-temperature nickel alloys, cobalt and zirconium alloys as well as high-alloyed special stainless steels. These materials are used in the chemical process industry, the oil and gas industry, aerospace, automotive and electronics / electrical engineering. VDM Metals operates production sites in Germany (Altena, Siegen, Unna and Werdohl) and the United States (Florham Park, NJ, and Reno, NV). The company employs about 2,000 people worldwide.

Kathrein-Werke KG.company_description: Kathrein-Werke KG is a German manufacturer of antenna systems and related electronics. The company was founded in Rosenheim in 1919 and is still headquartered there. It is the world's oldest and largest antenna manufacturer, valued at about $1.8 billion in 2015. The company produces antennas for GSM and UMTS mobile radio towers and for various car manufacturers such as BMW. Most satellite receivers and satellite parabolic antennas for radio and television reception are developed and partly produced by Kathrein in Germany. Many radio and television antenna towers in Germany are equipped with Kathrein antennas. In February 2019, the core business with mobile phone antennas and filters was sold to the Swedish network supplier Ericsson.

Techem GmbH.company_description: Techem GmbH operates in the metering industry and offers products and services for energy management, carbon dioxide reduction in apartments and commercial real estate. SGL Carbon SE.company_description: SGL Carbon SE is a European company based in Germany and is one of the world's leading manufacturers of products from carbon. In 2022, the company generated sales revenue of €1,135.9 million and employed 4,760 staff worldwide.

MLP SE.company_description: MLP SE is a Germany-based holding company engaged in the investment management and fund operators industries. Zech Group GmbH.company_description: Zech Group GmbH is a global conglomerate with more than 300 companies and over 12,000 employees, operating in the construction and real estate business, hotel industry, and various industrial sectors. Städtisches Klinikum München GmbH.company_description: Städtisches Klinikum München GmbH is a municipal hospital in Munich, Germany. Alba SE.company_description: Alba SE is a German professional basketball club based in Berlin, Germany. It is considered to be the most successful German basketball team, having won eleven German Championships, eleven German Cups, three German Supercups, and the FIBA Korać Cup in 1995. The club competes in the German League and the EuroLeague or the EuroCup, and hosts its home games at the Mercedes-Benz Arena Berlin. With an average attendance of more than 10,000 fans per game in a season, it is also one of the most popular basketball clubs in Europe.

Volkswagen Financial Services AG.company_description: Volkswagen Financial Services AG is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group, which offers a range of financial services including financing, leasing, and fleet management for Volkswagen vehicles and other brands under the Volkswagen Group. The company provides financial products and services to support the sales of vehicles from the Volkswagen Group's various brands.

It is a partner of the holding company DBH Deutsche Buch Handels GmbH & Co. KG, which competes for being the major book trading company in Germany with its rival Thalia. The company manages about 465 branches with about 3500 employees and is a significant player in the German publishing and media retail industry.
